title: Inexpensive Option for Home Unit Install
text:
I've just completed installing and properly tuning a split system air conditioner and evaporator coil to work with my existing gas furnace. I bought the equipment, the R410a, and about $1000 worth of specialty tools (no shortcuts) - almost all online (95% Amazon). I did this - after loads of research - because I wanted to ensure that my specific installation wishes would be fulfilled. And I still saved $1500 over the lowest bid (and that guy completely ignored a specific request).

This vacuum pump easily evacuated my 2 ton system with 33' lines (3/4 and 3/8) down to 300 microns in less than half an hour. For the price, I'm thrilled. I also feel it is pretty good quality, and I'm happy to have it around. If you need to get a lower vacuum than that, I believe you need a 2 stage model.

The one thing I don't like is that this model (like their other one-stage models) is that it does not have a shut-off valve, meaning as soon as you turn the pump off, your system returns to atmosphere unless you add one in-line or find another way to isolate your system while you wait to be sure the vacuum doesn't disappear with the pump shut off.

As someone else mentioned, I don't believe they supply the best oil available, and in this case it was just enough to fill it to max one time, and then it seemed to dispel some of the oil while I was running it a lot trying to get my vacuum gauge to work properly. So...buy some extra oil in case you need it.

title: Great Value
text:
I bought this primarily for assisting with moving things in and out of my basement, and I had fabricated a device to attach it to a tree. It's a great product, it works, it's reasonably priced, and everybody seems to like it, but there are a few things that could be better:

1) Would like to see longer control leads because the current leads leave you mostly stationary, especially when the winch is mounted up high.

2) Pulling a ~1000lb boiler up a low-friction ramp had it stalling after an inch or so of pull each time. I doubt it was a power issue, because we had two batteries and a charger in series. Not really a product problem, just remember to account for gravity and friction... Also, high amperage power supplies are surprisingly expensive if you're not using a running 12V battery.

3) Respooler beat up my line a little bit in the process.

4) Fuse holder should be built in to main power line; that would mean one less connection to make and then positive and negative leads could be the same length.

5) Would prefer alligator clamps for connections, rather than having to keep track of multiple washers and nuts each time.

Anyway, it's still a great device that I'm happy to have around. Might consider a higher capacity model if I were doing it over again.

title: Dyna plugs usually work, I carry liquid rubber cement with this kit.
text:
So OK, this tire plugging kit works well.....when it works. There are two small issues with this kit. 1-The brass tip of this plug is very hard to insert if you've got a small puncture hole. 2-if you've got a large puncture hole in your car tire you might use all the plugs you've got (remember 5 plugs cost $10!)...... and it still might end up leaking when you're done. Here's a tip - I have a couple of these kits on my bikes and I always carry a tube of liquid rubber cement with the kit to lube the puncture hole prior to inserting the Dyna plug. This tends to work well on small to average size holes. For automotive use,
I always have the standard "rope" type plugging kit in the car or truck (that have the large rope plugs and rubber cement included). With the rope type plugs, you can "ream" the hole larger and insert the standard rope plug to match the reamed hole size. I've never had a problem with the rope type plugs. I believe these Dyna Plugs are primarily meant for motorcycle tires or small puncture holes in car tires. I also always cut the exposed cord or rope that's hanging out of the tire after the tire has been fixed.

title: Good quality portable air pump
text:
This pump is a really good value for the money. It can run off the cigarette lighter, or directly from your battery. The flashlight isn't very bright, but it will help you make your connection in the dark. It comes with a convenient carrying bag.

My husband used this on our Grand Cherokee as soon as it arrived. All 4 tires needed a little air. He connected it directly to the battery, and it reached all the tires except the back driver's side. For that one, he had to connect to the cigarette lighter. The unit was hot to the touch after using, and had to sit and cool off before being stored.

There's no user manual included, but it isn't too hard to figure out. This is nice to have in your vehicle in case of emergencies. And I don't know how it is where you live, but public air pumps are getting harder and harder to find around here.

text: I cannot state enough how sturdy and strong this snow brush is! This is not a flimsy brush! I love that it comes apart, so you can store it more easily if you need to - it comes in a nice box. The brush side is large and the bristles seem very durable but yet they will be gentle on the finish of your vehicle. One nice thing about this brush is that you can rotate the brush, so you can put it into a position that works best. The handle extends, so you can really get lots of reach! I could reach the other side of the car and the roof from just one side, which is really nice. The other end has an ice scraper and again, it's substantial and strong. You could use the ice scraper without the handle if you want. I've never had such a wonderful snow brush and I feel that it will last a long time. Love this and it would be a great gift item!

text:

Everyone should have one of these in case their car breaks down. It has a magnet that seems pretty strong, so you can stick this onto almost any area of your car.

This thing is Super Bright! It says you can see it from almost a mile away and I think that's entirely possible.
It has multiple settings so you can flash or have a steady light with various options. It also has a simple flashlight in the middle. It has a hook, so you could hang it, for instance if you need to look under the hood. The hook also acts as a stand, so you could place this on the ground. FYI, it takes 3 AAA batteries, not included.

title: Nice Portable Tire Inflator!

This is very convenient so I don't have to use a manual pump or walk my bike to the gas station to get air. The unit is very nice and it's easy to use. There are presets for various common tire types but you can also just set your own. The unit has a place to hold the tube and tips. It would have been nice to have a small pouch to keep it in so you can make sure you don't lose the connector for charging. It is slightly heavy but not too bad. I will have to keep it in a backpack if I want to take it with while riding my bike. If you are using it for car tires, I think it would only inflate a couple of them at a time before it needs to charge, depending on how much air you have to put in. If you're just adding a little bit of air it should be fine for all four tires. Charging takes a while but that is what I expected. All in all, a very nice upgrade and once you have it you won't know how you ever lived without it.

title: Gets the job done - but slowly
text:
This tool is very handy. I've had a Coleman compressor for 10 years and never liked having to make sure the back tires were within reach of the compressor's hose and/or power chord. This little gadget definitely solves that problem. But there are downsides: for one, it's a whole lot slower to add a couple lbs of pressure. What used to take a few seconds (after the compressor built up its internal pressure - which takes a minute), now takes minutes per tire. What's worse, the hose that comes with the pump isn't very long, so if the tire stem is near the top of the tire, you'll have to hold the pump, find something higher to lay it on, or let it hang, hoping nothing gets damaged.

The accuracy of the pressure that the pump displays isn't very accurate. When I have it set to 42lb, oftentimes it stops when the actual pressure is more like 38. Other times, however, actual pressure matches the preset pressure. I wish it was one or the other, because as is, I always either have to let air out or add some more.

Overall I'm pretty happy, though. Its battery has more than enough juice to add a few lbs to 4 tires. Possibly twice over. And it's not terribly loud - probably no louder than my Coleman was when it was coming up to pressure.. Best of all, I can keep this in the glove compartment in case of emergency (it also doubles as a flashlight). I was tempted to give it 4 stars, but the short hose is a really annoying shortcoming, in my opinion.

text:
Since I’m not about to test this, I can’t comment on whether it works to break a window in an emergency. I will just have to trust that it does, and hope I will never have cause to find out for certain.
It’s a simple bracelet made of stretchy cord with two slip knots and a tungsten carbide bead. No instructions were included, and I admit that at first, I had no idea how I’d ever attempt to break glass with it. Turns out you use it like a slingshot, stretching the bracelet and smacking the bead against the window. That information is in the product description on the Amazon page. You should also slide it so it’s at maximum length before using to break glass. I played around with one of the bracelets and found it’s not so easy to slide the knots to adjust the size of the bracelet. Once I got it to its maximum size (that part wasn’t too hard) I struggled to again make it small enough for my wrist and ended up untying one of the knots.
If you’re concerned about having to break auto glass in case of an emergency, perhaps this will give you some peace of mind, but I can’t see myself putting it on my wrist every time I get in the car.

title: Great portable car charger.
text:
Type S, PROJUMP 26000
This device is well designed and packaged. All functions operated exactly as described in the user’s manual. I did not try out the usb outlets, since I only need this device to perform as a starter. My lawn tractor is notorious for not fully charging it’s battery so I used this as my trial. It took somewhere between 45 to 60 seconds for the lawn tractor to start. And start it did.
Assessment: I charged the Projump approximately 30 days ago. I was still registering 99% on the charge meter after being left on the shelf for this period of time. After starting my 23 hp lawn tractor as described above, it was still at 93%. At this rate, using the guidance of only starting an engine when the ProJump is over 50% charged, I should be able to get up to 6 more starts before needing a recharge. This is good. This indicates that if I were using this to jump start any of my automobiles, there would be plenty of power in the ProJump to get my automobiles and truck started.
The connections for the jumper cables to the ProJump are very secure and leave no doubt they will stay connected during use. It is a real safety feature that all sides of the clamps are protected to prevent any inadvertent touching to each other or other things in the car except for the intended terminals on the car battery. The clamps are also very tight ensuring a good connection but still not too difficult to squeeze to make a proper connection to the car battery.
The carrying case makes it easy to toss the device under the seat of a car or in the storage compartment and not get tangled, dirty or damaged from other normal items.
Areas for improvement:
1. The cables are relatively short. This makes for a very compact carrying package, but can be somewhat of a challenge to find a good place to lay the ProJump during use. Fortunately, the outer case is all rubber or plastic so there is no risk of having it bounce around and short out the terminals on the battery. If the cables were a little longer it would be easier to find a secure surface to lay the ProJump during use without having it dangle.
2. If the side opposite the flood light had magnets, it would really enhance the usefulness of the ProJump as a service light when stuck beside the road in the dark and also to secure the device in-place during use.
3. I tried connecting this device to three different batteries to see why the red and green lights continued to flash and the LCD message always said to “Clamp cables to battery”. Apparently, this was not an error, but just an indication that all 3 batteries I was testing were above 12.0 volts. However, when under test (starting), the ProJump responded correctly and proceeded to start my engine despite the instruction to make a connection.
Overall: This device appears to have been well thought out, is very compact, packs a lot of punch and is easy to use.

title: Patron Saint of Travelers
text: I got this for protection for a motorcycle. If you are religious and believe, this is a beautiful, personal and thoughtful gift for someone or yourself. The bell is a good size at almost 2" which is including the 'bail' and it's heavy duty metal with a blackened finish. The embossing is deep and stands out nicely. I like the wings on the side of the crest shape, just wish the features of St. Christopher and Jesus were a little more detailed. The bell actually rings and is a gracious gift for someone you care about.

title: Great sporty look and comfortable
text: I have a few of these cushions and I happen to like this one the best because of the cover which appeals to me. It doesn't look so much like a "medical" cushion with the large open mesh cover that reminds me of a race car. This is comfortable with quality thick memory foam and seat contours. I can sit comfortably on this for hours, no problem. There is also no shifting of the cushion and I am very happy that the cover can be removed and machine washed. If you are looking for a cushion with a little style don't hesitate to get this.

title: The perfect HOT PINK
text: I was looking for something to put in my car so I don't ruin the original mats and these are perfect. They are  thin but well made with hot pink accents and stitching, they are not red. The color is a perfect hot pink and is bright, even better than the photos in the listing, check out customer photos for a better representation. The black carpet fabric is similar to what you would find on the factory installed mats and the backing is non slip with nibs that grab well to secure them. They fit nicely in my Rogue. This is a good set and the price is right, so glad I got these.

title: For colder weather
text: These motorcycle gloves are made for colder weather. They are definitely thicker, have insulation and a soft fleece like lining as opposed to regular riding gloves. They are fabric with some leather parts along with the recycled material protection. They have the knuckle vents and protection for your fingers and palm. There is a velcro strap at the wrist that you can tighten and also a toggle at the edge of the cuff to keep the wind out. There are also some reflective strips on the fingers. I have not used these yet but they seem like good gloves and I will update when I do.

title: BEAUTIFUL, Soft, Excellent quality sheepskin/faux fur mix cover
text: This genuine sheepskin car seat cover is beautiful and superb quality. I am actually using it to cover my office chair so I can't comment on the fit for a car, however I have had these covers in the past and this one is made very well. The main areas of the back, seat and front of the headrest are sheepskin (which is foam backed) while all sides, the back of the seat cover and the back of headrest are faux fur (see last photo where the top of the seam is the faux fur and the bottom is genuine sheepskin). The headrest being a separate piece is also a great selling point. The skin is super soft and a somewhat short length with a buttery color. It is very comfortable and I highly recommend it.

title: Good Storage, Keeps Everything Organized!
text: Easy to install, and the back of the organizer has velcro strips to keep it flush against the back of the seat.  There are 2 pockets with velcro flaps (one small & one large), 2 mesh pockets, and 2 medium pockets.  In some spots the stitching isn't even (at least on the one I received).  It's great for holding re-usable bags (don't you always forget them when going to the store), 1st aid kit, rags, flashlight, umbrella, etc.  Not sure weight wise what this will hold overtime, but a great addition to the SUV, keeping all those "extras" we carry organized.

title: Good overall kit
text: This is a good overall kit. It has just about everything you need to clean your vehicle. The brushes are good quality, the small microfiber cloth is thick and soft and the kit also comes with a very large, almost bath sized microfiber towel. There are 2 round microfiber covered pads for waxing the car which are fine and a vent cleaner which looks like the ones you use to clean blinds. The disappointing articles are the duster and the microfiber glove which both look like they are dollar store items. The duster has a flimsy plastic handle and cheap yarn like loops with not much density and the wash mitt is very small, about 6 inches in length (see photo) which barely reaches my wrist and I've never seen such sparse loops. A collapsible wash bucket is also included. Overall this will do the job.

title: Great inflator
text: I purchased this inflator because I had a old car sitting in the driveway with tires that are low . When it was time to move it this inflator was powerful enough to fully inflate that tire.  Highly recommended !!’

title: Great vacuum
text: I live on a dirt road so rocks and chunks of dirt would frequently get into my car . This vacuum was perfect and powerful enough to get out all the dirt and rocks .

title: Does the job, stitching is a little abrasive
text:
These seatbelt covers attach by wrapping around the seatbelt and securing at the securely sewn on velcro strip. Material is soft, the velour covered foam with sewn quilted accent. They're sturdy and strong.
I have another set of these, different brand and slightly different that I like better. These ones are 2 in shorter, and the stitching which makes them look quilted can be a little rough and I'm afraid it will be abrasive on my bare skin in the summertime.
I am moderately happy with these, they are pretty and effective, but I wouldn't choose to buy them again, I'd go with the other brand that I have simply for the two reasons stated above.

title: Really good value!
text: We ordered this because our sensors were going bad. We intended to install them before now but my husband has been too busy. They look like good quality, they are a great price, and my husband is very pleased so that's all good! I will definitely update my review after installation if necessary.

title: Sturdy, convenient. wish the two keys were the same.
text:
This trailer hitch is sturdy. It fit perfectly into my receiver and it moves easily up and down with no forcing. The hitch itself is very good quality, but the two locking pins are less so. Not terrible, but they aren't quite as sturdy as I would like. It is very nice that the pins lock for security's sake, but it is a bit inconvenient to have to switch between 2 keys when unlocking both. It would be nice if they accepted the same key. Thankfully, I won't have to use one of them often as the hitch will stay attached to the truck most times.
I like the hitch, I had been wanted one for some time, and I recommend it in spite of the couple small issues.

title: Attaches securely, quality item
text: Well made and sturdy. Attaches securely and easily. Grease goes in smoothly. Sturdy ever. The tip is longer than some others I have, but the overall quality is much better. Recommended.

title: Easy to use, works well for keyboard
text: I had seen this many times and wondered about it. When it showed up as an available item I decided to try it. I used it on my keyboard, which is newish, but already getting dusty between the keys. I pressed this into it and it pulled up most of the dust and debris. There wasn't a lot and it didn't get the really deep stuff, but my keyboard looks a lot better. I don't think it will pick up a seriously hard, dried on dirt, but it's great for light cleaning. I'd buy it again, and it's reasonably priced.

title: Construction worker orange, not gold
text:
First thing when I opened the package was that I saw they were bright, construction worker vest orange. Not the gold shown that I wanted, but not a deal breaker. The package was taped and taped and taped. Bomb proof. I was concerned about cutting the fabric so I had to be very careful when opening. My mom with arthritis in her hands would have had a hard time with this.
These towels/cloths are very soft. It's hard to rate the absorbency because when saturated they are VERY absorbent. They hold a lot of water and soap, but when you take a dry cloth and try to dry an item they just smear the water around. I washed our bathroom counter that had some soap from the pump and the wet cloth picked up the soap, but it took a lot of rinsing to get it out of the cloth. Then when I tried to dry the counter with another, dry towel, it didn't dry well.
My evaluation is that these are very good for washing but not for drying. If there is much dust, though, they sort of push the dust around into a dusty mud that is not pulled into the cloth, you have to sort of fold the cloth and gather the debris inside. I can imagine that these would be great cloths for washing a car.
I think that cloths are good, but not anything special, and the price point is more than they are worth to me.

title: This item is SO helpful when you need it
text:
I don't know if it's just us, but between one thing and another, with 6 drivers we seem to be often in need to a charge or jump start.
This jump pack has already saved us from a tow or a long wait for a family member to rescue us. It is easy to use, and works well. Since I can't manufacture a need for it (Well.....I could, but don't want to run down a battery just to test how many charges we get out of it...) I can't say how often it needs to be recharged.
It is nice and small, easy to store in your car without taking up much room. We had another one, larger, for many years that we carried with us, but it took up 5x the space.
Suffice it to say that I am glad that I have this jump pack, and am sure we'll use it again and again.

title: Much better quality than expected, sturdy and elegant
text:
If you can call an ornament elegant, this is it. It's just nicely made was quality materials.
The ornament is thick, not thin and flexible. The beveled edges are a nice touch that adds a lot aesthetically.
The design is a decal. I can't speak as to its longevity but if it's a Christmas ornament or an ornament displayed elsewhere year round, it probably won't be handled much and I imagine it would last as long as the ornament itself.
It will make a nice gift, especially for an Argentinian football fan.

title: Heavy duty, high quality, and FUN
text:
I was out of town when these arrived, and my daughters opened the package. They texted me to tell me they LOVED these, and they claimed them right away. It's a good thing I ordered the three pack!
They are very sturdy, the carabiner clip is strong and springs back tightly. The key rings themselves are quality. I guess I didn't realize when I ordered them that the little flowers spun. How fun! They spin freely, my husband says that they spin on a bearing. As a machinist he was impressed with the keychain. He can't have one though, cuz the girls claimed them!
I'm glad I chose them, I would order them again, and I think they would make great gifts as well. High quality, good job WAPSAT.

title: Helpful light chart on front
text:
I haven't had a chance to evaluate how this works for surge protection as I can't anticipate a surge.
This plug is not heavy, it's made of hard plastic on the outside. I appreciate that there are indicator lights that are visible even when it is plugged in. The indicator chart on the front is helpful, but it is not visible when a cord is plugged into it. It indicates if the plug is grounded, hot, and a couple other variations, as well as telling you if the connection is correct.
I chose this for my parents who travel in their RV a lot, and I'll post an update if necessary after they have taken a trip with this.

title: It works, a little confusing at first. Not much for directions
text:
Bought this because our handyman keeps leaving light on - his car, our cars, over and over!
We gave him this to carry in his car and he needed it the day after we gave it to him.
He said that if was confusing to use because of the lack of directions, but he figured it out and it got the car started.
Such a handy little gadget to have. I'd like to get one for all our kids.

title: Air compressor works very well, convenient!
text:
This little mini air compressor and battery charger is a great tool. It works very well to fill up a low tire. You have to turn on and attach the hose in a certain order, but do it once and you'll remember. My son was really impressed and wouldn't mind one of his own.
The battery charger part is the primary reason we bought this since on one of our cars you can pull the key out of the ignition before the car is fully off and our handyman ALWAYS drains the battery. It works well for starting our dead car. I'll update after I see how many starts we get out of one charge.
The size is great for keeping in your trunk for emergency use. Bigger than the newer jump start only battery packs, but not large at all.
I am pleased with this jump starter/mini air compressor.

title: Not quite one size fits all.
text:
We recently bought a used Prius and the arm rests are very hard and uncomfortable. We bought this for the center console and this padded cover is much bigger. Thought about returning it, but decided to keep it and it just works, rubbing the edges of both seats. The padding, however, is bliss compared to the hardness of the console.
I would buy it again, but I might look for more true to size cover. The price was reasonable, which is why I bought it instead of how much more expensive model specific cover.
It was very easy to put on and it does not slip.

title: Works great
text: Very nice and does the job great!

title: Works very well
text: Had to replace original set .  Hoping these last longer than the other ones did.

title: Yes, but...
text: Hey, they're great & easy to install. I have noticed that the driver seat one moves around a bit, especially when I am leaving the seat & settling in to the seat. I believe I may not have installed them correctly, but not sure. I can't find the packaging it came in, unfortunately, so I don't know what to do about that. I noticed there was a strap on the bottom, not sure what that's for. Also a zipper for headrest adjustment, I suppose? Anyway, overall I love the seat covers; I just felt like I couldn't get the driver side to fit like the passenger side.

title: Looking good so far
text: We've only had one bout of snowfall so far this year, but I did use the cover to protect my car from the snow and it worked just fine. The owl head is cool, and the stripes on the side mirror slots help me figure which way to turn it when I'm covering it. It also comes with a cord and lock. I personally didn't use those, but may be handy for others.

title: Missing Attachment. Misleading advertisement, beware
text: MISSING BROOM ATTACHMENT!!!!! Earth to Grab-it makers, Your customers are not getting the full product as advertised. Do something about it! I mean, sheesh, I read the reviews of other people who said they were missing the attachment, & I just thought to myself, "well, there's no way that I will be missing the attachment too, maybe those customers just ordered on a bad day." And then it happened to me too! Wow. Someone's not doing their job right. Even more shocking, no one CARES that someone's not doing their job right & customers are unhappy. The actual product itself works fine & I really wanted to give this item at least a three star... But the more I thought about it, the more I began to feel displeased about the misleading advertisement, & no effort has been made to fix the issue.

title: lucky if u can open it up
text:
This is a terrible design....Lucky if you can get it opened without a knife...

That alone makes it terrible product as frustration. I still have the one pack as you literally need a knife to open the container.

title: Shortens scrapping time
text: Not having to scrap frost off of my windshield shortens the amount of time I am out in the cold, and helps me not be late for work -- all good things. This fits securely, even in high winds. I recommend it to anyone who doesn't have a carport or garage and lives in a place with cold winters.

title: These work!
text: I don't know what it is, but other cars love passing me on my right, and I have cars who hang out in my blind spot on my left. This is a problem when I am driving to work each morning at 65-70 mph. These have pretty much eliminated those blind spots. I used the attachment that allows you to adjust the mirrors, and everything has stayed stuck on, even with rain, frost, and extreme humidity.

title: Great way to organize
text: I am the sort of person who just throws stuff into their car and manages to lose things. This has helped tremendously in keeping me organized.

title: A bit too large, but nice looking
text: It looks nice, but it's a bit too large for my 2008 Toyota Corolla. I couldn't get the tabs behind the car seat to fasten in place, which would make this a problem if I had back seat passengers, but I don't. I will probably replace this at some point, but for the time being, it works as a good looking protectant for putting groceries and baggs on.

title: Easy to install
text: I have a 2008 Corolla, and these fit perfectly and were super easy to install. They stay in place with no bunching.

title: Would buy again
text: I wanted to wait to see how these lasted before writing a review. I am very pleased with the hubcaps. I very easy to install, requiring more finesse than strength. It took around a minute a tire (and I am not mechanically inclined). Be sure to watch the video instructions- it really helps. I have driven over rough roads and train track, and they have stayed on with no damage. Since they are plastic, I assume they will get damaged eventually, so I ordered two sets so I can replace as needed. They look really nice on the car. I will definitely purchase these again.

title: Innovative, works!
text: I was quite surprised at this and turns out I was right to get it :).  Opens like an umbrella on a short shaft, stays firmly in place, coated for heat/light penetration, folds up for storage in a sturdy pouch.  Only thing...Does not fold up as slickly for me as video shows ;p ...but does so can be easily stowed away

title: Easy once you
text: These filters are so much more economical to order & do yrself!  Arrived in perfect shape, ordered one for each our cars.  Getting behind glove box forced me also to get all the old papers and crap out of there too, extra benefit!  These filters are sturdy, filter part dense enough to last quite a while.  Should be able to brush out a bit of the built up debris at least once before replacing too

title: Suction could be better
text: First of all, windows need to be very clean.  Once on, they provide filtered shade in a part of the window.  The rims are flexible, maybe a bit floppy for quick applying.  I've had on securely and had them just fall down

title: Fits my Veloster w/room left
text: This comes in a black bag, nicely tied up inside, lol..Don't think it will ever fit back in it for me though!  Best thing to do is fully spread it out and get yr bearings w/the design.  Once I did that I could tell front, back, mirror arm pockets, etc.  This has elastic bands front back to stretch under carriage and the whole thing has elastic edge around.  Not super thick but certainly covers for the weather, tree sap, bird stuff.  Super handy

title: Looked too short
text: Happily it works well and easy to put on..once you see where to unsnap the plastic.  Fits nice & tight to windshield on my Hyundai

title: Wow! Handy assortment of needed
text: The only thing you need to add to this awesome array is a flat head screwdriver, wrench, maybe some gloves... This has not only cables, tarp, tools, emergency kit, lol, even incls safety pins!  Black heavy duty tape, so many useful things in a sturdy zip bag.  bag even has a strip of reflective tape on the front of it!  Usually in my husbands car but we also transfer from 1 car to another.  Have to get another one of these so both cars are equipted.  Excellent gift too

title: Excellent for reflective
text: Put this in back bumper of both our cars..for "our" safety.  No student drivers here but it does catch the attention of other drivers and probably makes them pay closer attention to our car and avoid up ;p.  Definitely stays stuck on thru all kinds of weather too!

title: Work well
text: I can truthfully say that I read directions...I'm not sure what I did right but got this on.  I pulled and jiggled, got old off and pretty much did the same getting new one on..color me happy!

title: Lady's choice!
text: I'm not an expert at any car maintenance but I got these, put on myself and wow, can't believe the difference in looking thru my windshield!  I didn't realize my wipers were so crappy and worn, guess just used to looking through them.  These are strong sturdy rubber and are shaped for close fit to my windows.  There is a little area that is supposed to become yellow as the wipers age from the sun /weather.  Instructions are easy, you don't need anything but yr own power to put these on

title: A bit of leak
text: When I got this 4 pack and opened, it was wet inside and not water.  I think some of the gel had melted in 1 of the containers.  The tops are sealed metal that you open with a pull tab but bottoms are cardboard/plastic or something.  Scent is super light and you can adjust the lid to have more or less gel inside exposed to freshen air.  I think these work the best in small confined spaces rather than a regular sized room..try a car, closet, something like that.  Sorry, just not doing a lot for my house

title: Sorry but this is noxious
text: This smells like 1) oiled machinery.. or at best.. 2) oily leather.  Husband thinks after it fades a bit it's closer to the oily leather smell. Highly flammable.  You have to use it then stay out of the car for 5 minutes.  Can be used on a noxious smell to deodorize or just general air freshener.  Frankly, to me...it's awful but to someone else?

title: Works great on 2005 Hyundai too!!
text: What all can you say about a wiper blade?  I put this on myself and didn't have any problem!  Think it's awesome because I could use it on my 2005 Hyundai!!  We haven't had much rain but a whole lot of dust so using wipers alot just to clean windshield..this does excellent even wipe.  Bosch is known as a great product company and I think this is another good one that they have

title: Good stuff but..
text: buy this at a local store!  Highly recommend not having it shipped to you.  The can I rec'd was bulging at the end from the heat even though it was well packaged.  Can says avoid heat, undue pressure..can may burst.  Sure the post office loves this kind of stuff being shipped... The tire shine worked good for me even though I was afraid to shake the can too much!  The nozzle has low/med/high settings for the spray.  I used the low and pretty carefully went around the tire a couple times.  Directions say not to get on tread.  Also not for use on bike as it will make it slippery.  Tires shine like they are wet looking..it's nice looking!

title: Another great wiper by Bosch
text: The Bosch 22OE-CA Clear Advantage Beam wiper blade is one of the best wiper blades I've put on my car. I live in south Texas where we have alot of morning fog, and when it does rain it is inches in an hour. This blade gives me a clean clear windshield through it all. No streaks or missed spots. I actually did'nt even get that annoying thumping noise when I left the wipers on after the rain stopped. I would recommend this wiper to everyone.

title: Great for my wife
text: My wife is gifted in the bust so seat belts can be uncomfortable for her at times so when I saw this I snatched it up.  It arrived just fine with no defects that I could see.  The eagle on it is a bit ridiculous but I found it funny.  It feels pretty well put together and we haven't had any issues in using it so far.  Basically, what you do it put it apart using the toggle on it attach it to the lap belt and close it, then take the shoulder belt and tuck it in the front slot.  It was pretty easy to get going we did have to make small adjustments for it to be as comfortable as she wanted but that was easy.  All in all, if your seat belt isn't fitting comfortably this lets you change it a bit so it is while still providing safety.

title: Nice little vehicle air freshener
text: I needed something for my truck as it didn't stink but the air was stale so I got this to pep up the air.  It came packaged just fine with no defects I could see.  In the box, you get the air freshener and 4 scent packets.  To get the packets into the air freshener you have to pull the propeller out and jam them behind the bobblehead.  I like the scent on the packets it was a musty earthy scent so perfect for my truck.  I left it sitting in my closed truck for about an hour and when I got it the truck smelled way better.  The one issue I have is my vents flaps are a bit loose so when I put it on the plane did a nose dive but that's small potatoes compared to making my truck smell good.

title: Great for the lid of a laptop
text: I work in IT and this comic speaks to my soul so when I found all these stickers I knew I needed them for my laptop.  They came packaged just fine with no rips or tears.  You get 4 of each kind of sticker for a total of 16.  Putting it on my laptop was fine, I just cleaned my laptop with some rubbing alcohol and wiped it off, and stuck it on.  So far it has held pretty well so I'm happy with it.  If you like this comic you will like the stickers.

title: Blows my 2 year old daughters mind
text: I'm always looking for new things to get my daughter's attention and keep it so she doesn't destroy the house (alas she still destroys the house) so I figured I would get her something that flew to blow her little mind.  This is a pretty simple set up you get a flying ball that charges off of a micro USB (boo to it not being a c but whatever), a remote (requires 4 aaa batteries), and a charging cable.  The ball took about 30 or so minutes to first charge so that's not bad.  When you get everything put together you simply turn the ball and the remote on and it's ready.  The ball can only really go up and down it is at the mercy of air to go right or left, I wish it could but that to me is the only drawback.  Getting it to hover is a challenge when you are first learning it but I was able to get it to hover.  My daughter tries to reach for it and says it's "so cool".  The ball and propellers can take quite a beating as I have had a couple of hard crashes.  All in all, this is kinda neat I wish you could control the direction instead of just up and down but for what it is my daughter likes it.

title: Great for trying out waterless diffusers
text: I have been really digging these waterless diffusers lately and this is my fourth one so I've seen a couple of them.  This guy comes with a pretty easy interface one button and three settings.  I wanted to handle a large area so I have been using the 3-blip mode almost exclusively.  It puts out a great amount of aroma and does not take long to charge.  One of the best things I like about this is the 30 ml tank that it has with it so I am able to fill it and forget it for quite a while.  If you are looking to try out a waterless diffuser this is a great starting point.

title: Great for peace of mind on a ling car trip
text: We are getting ready to take a bit of a long road trip so I’ve been trying to take care of any issues we could possibly have before it happens.  Out of the box, I charged it for about 4 hours and it became full.  We have not had to use it to jump a car yet, but it does give us peace of mind that if something happens on the road we have it to help us out.  I did however try the power bank and flashlight feature.  The power bank works just fine and I was charging my phone so if you are stranded that would be a good help.  The flashlight also works well so if you are stranded it will come in handy.  It came in a nice carrying case that I have put in our emergency kit in the car for the trip.  I really like this as it gives me peace of mind that if we have battery problems we can A. Jump the car, B.  at least keep our cells charged, and C. if it's at night we have a flashlight.

title: Easy to install and makes my neck feel so much better while driving
text: We are getting ready to take a long road trip so I've been searching for things to make the drive a bit easier on us so I got this pillow.  Setting it up was a breeze but I do have two tips.  One on the sides of the pillow where it attaches to the thing that attaches to the headrest press those wings down to make it go on easier.  Two when you put the thing that attaches to the headrest on put the spacers on first if you need them, makes it a lot easier.  As for the comfort, it is super comfy and makes my neck feel so much better when driving.  I highly recommend this if you are going on a long trip.

title: Good for larger drinks
text: I recently got a couple of thermoses that after getting I learned did not fit in my truck's cup holder.  This came in two pieces one was the actual cup holder and the second was a thing to put in your vehicle's cupholder to hold it in.  You put it together with a little screw and so far it has held just fine.  The twist into my cupholder worked just fine.  And it is able to hold my bigger thermoses along with my regular drinks just fine.  I really like this as I don't have to have my drinks rolling around in my truck now.

title: Good for short people and tall vehicles
text: With the weather in my neck of the woods starting to turn snowy earlier than I expected this year I needed something to clean off my truck.  I'm not a tall guy and my truck is decently tall so I knew I needed something that was telescoping.  This is super simple to put together just two clicks and it is firmly in place.  The brush is great for snow while the ice scraper worked on the icy stuff.  All in all, I like this as it gives me the reach I need to for cleaning my truck.

title: Potent with a sample of scents.
text: This comes with Grape, Jasmine, Vanilla, and Rose tins. In the small space of a vehicle, these are potent but not overpowering.  Grape was the outlier for me in that I didn't know if I would like it but turned out really enjoying it.  If you like these scents they will make your car smell like the scent.

title: Great scents!!
text: I immediately opened the Mulled Holiday air freshener when I received my order. It smells like winter cranberry scents that I love! I put this in my car and left it for a few hours. I went back to my car to get a book out of the back seat and I smelled the wonderful scent right away. It had already filled the car. I wouldn’t say it’s overpowering though. I hate it when air fresheners are so strong they practically give you a headache, so I would definitely buy this again since the amount of fragrance is just right. These are great winter scents, not just for the holidays.

title: One Star
text: Did not fit. Was returned

title: Faraday bag
text: It is exactly what we were looking for, we bought 2.  Especially now with the chinese balloon at emp altitude

title: Worth it
text: China made.  Not all connections to the vehicle were precise.  Minor fixes made it well worth the money.  Prices locally were twice as much for high grade salvaged parts

title: This lockout kit is good
text: I got this thinking it was only the long reach tool, but it is a complete lockout kit with wedges, airbags, the (4 piece) bar, a bunch of other little accessories and a carry bag. I have used other kits and this one seems like a good package. The bar itself screws together which is a compromise- I prefer the one piece bar, but this is way more portable and folds into a small carry kit. I expect to get good use out of this kit.

title: great folder for you car
text: I never have to worry about if I have any of my car information since I have this thing. It holds all of my registration informiaton and insurance information nicely. Fits well into my glove box as well.

title: Good Devise to have
text: This came well packaged and easy to set up and use. While we have not used it on any vehicle tires, it has been used and works great for bike tires and playground balls.

title: super Cute
text: These would make a great gift. They could sit on a rearview mirror or from a window. They are heavier then I thought but still hold up well

title: Good to have

title: BluBird air hoses are the best, especially in cold weather.
text:
I've been using, and switching over to, BluBird hoses for a few years now. They're just great :-)
The best hoses I've used are these, and the hybrids (Flexzilla, etc). They're pretty similar in important specs - light weight and cold weather flexibility. I have a slight preference for the BluBird as it's less slippery and less springy, so I find it easier to handle and less of a tripping hazard. BluBird is also a much better value, especially when bought on sale :-)
I prefer BluBird's brass ends to Flexzilla's aluminum ones, though I wish they had reusable replacement end fittings like Flexzilla does. They sent me some prototype 3/8 fittings last year that I found awkwardly heavy and bulky. They hadn't produced 1/4" fittings yet. I was (and am still) hoping to be able to build my own custom leader hoses from BluBird hose, but for now I use Flexzilla for that purpose.
The only other hose I would consider is Goodyear rubber, but it's much heavier and not quite as flexible, though arguably more resistant to physical abuse if you really insist on mistreating your hoses.
Throw out those awful PVC hoses from the big box stores and buy BluBird. You won't regret it.

title: Great radiator, lousy packing
text:
One star because of the packing. It's useless if you can't get it undamaged.

The radiator is excellent, with the right brackets and fittings included.
Unfortunately Amazon insists on tossing the steel & brass accessories loose in the box with the aluminum radiator, so by the time it arrives it looks like it went through a hailstorm. 30 seconds and a piece of tape/bubblewrap would fix the problem but they wouldn't do that -- just kept sending me replacements the same way. Eventually I gave up.

Regarding the '96 Buick mentioned earlier -- if you just have transmission oil cooling you should be fine with the adapters included. If you also have engine (crankcase) oil cooling lines you'll need additional adapters for those. (There are separate oil coolers at each end of the radiator.)
Better yet add a separate after-market oil cooler for the engine, and cross connect the built-in coolers so they both cool the transmission. That's how the factory set the radiator up for tranny only cooling.

title: The GETLMUL Car Emergency Kit is a good basic emergency kit
text:
Car emergencies aren't fun. Having this kit won't make it fun, but will make it more palatable.
A lot of folks seem to be pitching this kit towards females because this kit is largely pink (the safety vest and tow strap are not)- I would say the bright pink color makes it extremely easy to locate in any vehicle, especially if you don't have a ton of other pink stuff in it (this case also has a shiny strip on the front, which catches light well).

My favorite pieces of this kit are the reflective triangle to get traffic's attention you're on the roadside, the reflective vest (which even if not a perfect fit, can likely be worn open so you still shine a bit), the jumper cables (which are an excellent staple in any car kit) and the flashlight (another essential and this one doesn't require batteries! You release a lock that release a pump handle to charge the light).

I'm also happy there's a whistle with compass, though it would have been nice if they'd included a note about whistle codes, though it's easy to look up.

The first aid kit is pretty bare-bones, but it is very nice to have a triangle bandage (to make a sling with) included. If I were using this to outfit someone I loved very much, I would supplement the first aid kit with some additional items, the other things are pretty on point.

My only "complaint" is the product title states this kit includes a "shovel", they mean "ice scraper". While you certainly could use it to move snow from around a tire in a pinch, a shovel it is not. Overall, a very minor complaint.

title: Excellent basic emergency supply kit - itanso 11pcs Car Emergency Kit
text:
What drew my attention to this set was the color (easy to identify in the vehicle, especially in a low light situation), the sturdy case (soft-shell, but somewhat firm) and the reusable magnetic "flares" (LED lights).

Last winter, we were returning from visiting friends for the holidays, hit a pothole and blew a tire. We pulled off the road to call for help, and I'll spare you the remainder details but we were out in rural (no lights) area waiting for the tow truck for several hours. I realized we were not as well prepared as we could have been and I been trying to piece together a more robust supply set since.

What I love:
> this covers the essentials, emergency hammers, a reflective vest, an emergency blanket, a pair of gloves and the "flares"
> the "flares" are reusable, bright and magnetic. You don't have to put them in the road and hope they don't get lost in snow, or hit by a passing vehicle- slap 'em on your rims or any metal on your vehicle
> the kit is compact and won't take up a lot of space in your vehicle

I have no true complaints, though I will say that the vest is "one size fit many", but because it has a hook and loop closure in the front, other folks can likely wear it open- it's better to have some reflective material on than none!
Similarly, the gloves (as noted by other reviewers) are thin- I don't consider this as a deal breaker because something is better than nothing, gloves that are too thick can hinder manual dexterity, and using the kit's gloves for whatever you need roadside may allow you to keep any good gloves you have from getting wet so you still have a toasty pair to put on.

While some folks may shy away from the pink, frankly- in an emergency- tools are tools, and I think the reusable "flares" are more than worth any potential frowns at the color. I also think it's a little strange colorway for the kit is pink and the multi-tool is red and black.

If setting yourself up for a kit from scratch, this would make a great base product!

I used to have a cut pool noodle shoved in that space to stop things from falling down that slot. Now I can have extra storage and stop items from slipping down.
So happy to have this added to our vehicle. I'm really hoping the cup holder will work better than it looks.

title: I love these
text:
What a nice pack of microfiber cloths. I love using these for cleaning my glasses. It's the only type of cloth I'll use.
Because I clean my glasses a lot throughout the day, I had to hurry and wash up one while I was using the other small cloth I had.
The size of these is perfect. One cloth gets me through 3 days of cleaning my glasses. With having a nice big supply now, I don't have to rush to do a load of laundry every day.
The cloths are nice and soft. I love that they are lint free.
Love the value of this pack of microfiber cloths.

title: Perfect fit for RAV4
text:
This is such a nice fit on my RAV4. The only problem I had putting it on was those round chucks that slide in between the top and bottom of seat. Getting my hand in without it slipping and snapping back was a little difficult. It kept slipping and snapping back onto my finger. But, once I got it on, it is holding nice and tight.
Took me a little while to find something to hook onto under the seat. I had to go by pure feel because I couldn't get down enough to look under the seat. But again, got them hooked and it's holding great.
Looks fantastic! Not too much sliding around when I'm getting in and out of the car. Love the look and the feel of this.

title: It works.  Not perfect but it works
text:
Update: I had to take this out. With the main cup holder part being smaller at the bottom part than the top half, I can't even get a bottle of water to hold in it.

We have a RAV4. Only 2 cup holders in the front and so many times I wished we had another holder.
I followed what the video showed on adding the rubber gaskets along the sides. I had to do a double layer to get a tight fit in the one holder that's perfectly round. But, the main cup holder, on this rotation holder, is wider at the top then narrows down so small at the bottom part. Unless you have a perfect shaped cup (wide at top and very small at the bottom. who has a cup like that?) it won't go all the way down and be secured into the holder that way it should be. Don't understand why they didn't have the main cup holder just one size from top to bottom.
When I put it into the holder that's closer to the dashboard, I can twist the extended holder but can't put anything taller than the edges of the holder because the cup or bottle hits the dashboard and won't hold.
The other cup holder, in the RAV4, is a little odd shaped. Because of the little edge this extended cup holder has on the edge, to keep it balanced?, it doesn't fit right into that odd shaped cup holder of the car.
I added a total of 4 layers of the rubber gaskets and did get it to go into the other cup holder. It's not as snug as it should be but, it's holding.
Still, the issue is that because the main cup holder goes from 4 fingers wide to 3 fingers wide, nothing will fit securely into that one holder. I can probably put a capped bottle of water in it but that's about it.
I love the idea of this extended cup holder. It's just the small design issue that's a little bit of a problem.

title: Gas pours nice now
text:
I don't like how the new safety gas cans are now. I did purchase a similar replacement hose, similar to these, but it was more of a hassle filling my lawn mower because the gas flowed so slowly.
I saw these gas spout replacements and had to try them out. These come with a small vent you can add to your existing plastic gas container.
Comes with two different threaded caps, that hold the hoses on, so that you can use either one for what type of container you have.
The hoses fit perfectly on my 5 gallon plastic gas container.
The vents were SO easy to add. I didn't have the drill bit quite big enough that I needed. So, I used the largest one I had and just slowly worked on the sides of the drilled hole until it was just big enough for the vent to fit.
Had to push hard to get it to snap in but, it's nice and snug.
Now when I fill my lawn mower, I just open the vent, then take cap off the pour spout, and the gas flows out so nice. 10 mins less of holding up a full 5 gallon container of gas and wiggling it to get the gas out is a big deal for me.
I used 2 of the hoses and vents. I have the 2 extras for when I purchase more gas containers.

title: My daughter loves smiley faces
text: So this was perfect for her.

title: Always good to have a battery charger on hand
text:
For what we need a battery charger for, this little gem is perfect.
So many times we've gone out to start our riding mower, only to have the battery dead. I like that we can just plug this in, hook it up to the battery, and within an hour we're up and running again. Could be charged enough sooner. We just leave it set for an hour to be sure.
One of our daughters is color blind. So having the safety in case the clamps are reversed in a great thing to have. I also don't have to worry if one of the younger pre-teens decides to use it to mow the lawn.
The only thing I wished this had was some type of bag to keep it in. When we, or any of our kids, are going on a long drive, we like to put this in the trunk for "just in case". Being in some type of storage bag would protect it a bit.
A nice unit for the price. For as little as we actually need a battery charger, I'm sure this will last for many years.

title: So compact!  Inexpensive and works so well
text:
So many things I love about this charger. First the size. It is so nice and compact. Easy to keep in your vehicle and not take up so much trunk space.
Second thing I love is that it lets you know if you have the clamps on wrong. Big Big plus on that from me. I know it's easy to put red on positive and black on the negative but, there are times it's dark or you get so flustered because of a situation that you just aren't thinking right. Having a safety like this can be life saving.
I also love that this comes with a 12V accessory. Many times we've come across someone stranded that doesn't have cables in their car. And there are times the kids don't return mine! So I can just plug this into our lighter slot and can easily help charge up someones battery.
So many times the battery in our riding mower is too low to start it. I can plug this charger into an outlet, hook the cables up to the mower battery, and be out cutting my lawn within 15 mins.
These would be great gifts for me to buy the kids to keep in their vehicles.
A great price for having reassurance that you won't be stuck somewhere with a dead battery.

title: Sturdy stands but major safety flaw
text:
Was so happy to get these jack stands. With the help of a friend, we do our own brakes on our cars. Always hated working on them with the car only on a jack. Even though I leave the jack under the car, I love having these stands as an extra safety measure.
Easy enough to raise the car up to the height that's needed, put the jack stands under and set the holding height. Just have to adjust the height by pushing down on the lever while pulling the black, center column to the desired height.
My big issue is that there is no separate locking pin. Just a little upward pressure on the lever and the whole thing falls down to the lowest position. Why not add an additional safety feature like a locking pin?
The engineers that designed this obviously don't work under a vehicle using their own product. This is why I leave the jack under the vehicle at all times. Always...safety first!
Because of that big flaw, I can only give these jack stands 3 stars.
They're well made and seem very sturdy, when used properly. But, when someone can get seriously hurt while using these, I just can't rate it high.

title: Keeps vehicle clean and protected
text:
There are times that we go up to TN to spend a couple of weeks at a remote place where we camp and ride horses. During that time our Subaru is just parked outside. With friends there, we all just jump into their vehicle if we decide to go out somewhere.
We wanted something to cover it during that time to protect it from the hot sun, rain storms, dust, and any small stones being tossed about by vehicles driving around.
This waterproof cover is perfect for those times!
We did take it out to see if it even fit. No problem. Had a little extra inches to spare.
Only problem was trying to fold it back up to put it back into the storage bag. A pain!
Can't wait for summer and our trip. Will be nice having a nice clean car to get back into when we leave.

title: Great cargo carrier bag that helps keep traveling a little easier
text:
Great expandable carrier bag!
We needed something that we could tie up on top of our vehicle for when we travel.
Was easy enough to get tethered to our luggage racks. And once filled, I did add a couple ratchet straps around it to secure it more. Traveling at 70-80 mph, I just wanted to be more at ease at not losing the entire thing on the highway.
Because we travel with our dogs, I need as much room in the back of our vehicle as I can get. Having nice cargo bags, that attach to the top luggage racks, frees up my vehicle so my dogs can travel with more room and less stress.
We didn't hit any type of rain on our travels. So I really can't judge how well this bag will keep the insides dry. I did test it a little by spraying it down with a hose. I had a roll of paper towels inside and they stayed nice and dry. But, a long time in heavy rain? I don't know.
So, until I am 100% sure that it is waterproof, I will only transport items that I don't have to worry about getting wet in it.
It's so much cheaper owning a nice cargo carrier bag instead of renting some type of luggage carrier.
When we got home, I just emptied it out, folded it up, and have it stored in a nice small pocket area we have in the very back of our SUV.
This way I will always have it with us just in case it's ever needed in an emergency.
It did hold up very well for our first 1400 mile trip. No tears at all. Easy wiped clean before we stored it.

title: A nice cheaper way to travel and have more room in your vehicle
text:
Very happy with how much I can actually fit into this bag. Easily our 2 sleeping bags, our tent, both our large overnight/gym bags of clothes, and a medium size bag of misc things. Probably could fit a bit more into it but, there are things I just didn't want to mix with what we already had in it.
Was able to attach it to our roof top racks without any big problem. Being the first time ever using a carrier bag on top of our vehicle, I did add an extra ratchet strap around it just to make sure it was 100% secured. I really don't think we needed it.
I liked that it opened up the back of our vehicle so our dogs were more comfortable on our trip.
You can either load it up and then lift it onto the roof and secure it. Or you can set it up on the roof and then fill the bag. Depends on what you're putting in it and how heavy it is. It's been dry here and it wasn't raining during our trip. Only moisture we had was the night/morning dew. Everything inside kept dry.
I like how nice this carrier looks to be made. Material seems tough enough to withstand the outside elements when we travel and looks to be able to last for years of use.
If you travel and are looking for a cheaper way of having more room in your vehicle, for whatever reason, this is the best way to go.
Easily folds or rolls up for easy storage until it's needed.

title: Great hair putty for great looking hair all day long
text:
My wife loves this power putty. Blew dried her hair and then added a small amount of the putty to her hands. Worked it into her hair and then blew dried it a bit to shape it. Messed up her hair with her fingertips and off she went.
It's been 6 hours and her hair is still holding and looking great. She said when she went outside and her hair got a bit messed with the wind, she just fingered it back into place. No problem.
Only time it flattened is when she was driving and her head was against the headrest. When she got to work she just wet her hand and just squished up her hair.
No real odor to it once she had it on her hair. And she liked that it doesn't stick to her hands like some products do. Easily washed right off using just some warm water.
Great product that she'll probably keep using it.

title: Great mat set for protecting floors of your vehicles
text:
Perfect set of floor mats for our older car. I don't like carpeted mats because they get so dirty so fast and usually look nasty after a years use. Even faster if you live where the snow falls. (because of snow and dirt on boots and shoes melting onto the mats)
These will be easy to get in and out of the car. And will be so easy to just spray down to clean.
They are nice and heavy so they don't slide around.
They seem like they will last for years. Not bad for the low price they are.
Would I put them in a more high class vehicle? No. But for our older vehicle that we use a lot, this set is just what we needed.
This is the type of mats we put in our sons first car.

title: Great, quick replacement for my broken FOB case
text: Great, quick replacement for my broken FOB case.  I will buy this again whenever the little tab that goes on my key ring breaks.

title: Great to keep in car for ease of mind when traveling
text:
First of all, I love that I don't have to figure out battery type and size. I worry about my wife being stranded alone. Having this, to keep in the car at all times, eases my mind a little.
Has a nice digital screen to make seeing it a lot easier than the one I used to use.
I like the cord and cable wrap.
I really don't know anything about car engines but, I like that it also checks the alternator. For a mechanic that's a wonderful tool. For a non mechanic like me, at least I'd know that something else is wrong and maybe not just my battery.

Hopefully I won't have to use this too often but, it's good to know that my wife will have a little comfort when she's on the road by herself. It only weighs about 7 lbs and small enough for her to handle by herself. Also will alert her if she hooks the cables on wrong. Love that feature!

title: So many uses for this light!
text:
I am definitely going to be needing a few more of these handy lights for around the house because just one isn't enough!

I wasn't sure exactly what I would be using this light for until we were out and the car broke down. It just so happened that I had this flexit light in the car for some reason. How nice it was to have a nice bright light to see into the engine! Because this has magnets on it, I was able to stick it on the hood of the car and have both hands free. What a fantastic light source this turned out to be that evening!
I was afraid of putting this on top of my car, with the blinking lights, as caution lights. So many times very bright blinking lights attracts drivers eyes and accidents happen.

Then I had to crawl under my sink to tighten one of the bolts. I usually stand my flashlight up so I can see. I always knock it over with my elbow as I'm crammed under there. Went to my car and got this Flexit light. Wow! How nicely bright it was to see with no flashlight falling over.

I haven't had a reason to wrap it around anything, yet. I don't think I'd wrap the lighted part around anything because I would be afraid of breaking the lights. Or it would cover a lot of the lights and not be as bright.

I've been reading comments on this and people are talking about 2 lights being on when on the low setting, then 4 lights for next setting.
Mine isn't like that. All the lights come on with lowest setting but they're dim. Click again and the lights get brighter. Click again and they are at their brightest. One more click and the lights blink.
They might have redesigned this from when the previous comments were made.

Right now the one I have will be kept in the car for emergencies. Would like to purchase a few more to keep in the house.
We lose our power a lot in the summer and in the winter because of ice. A few of these would be perfect for those times to light the house up enough to see.

title: I may have gotten a bad blade?
text:
We put these on our vehicle the day after we received them. Directions very easy to follow and got them on with no problems at all. The next day it rained a little while my car was parked. Turned on the wipers to clear the window of the few drops that were on it and sure enough there was one spot that left a streak mark of uncleared water. Right in my eyesight, of course.
Could be just a fluke that I got one bad blade. Will have to take these off and put my old ones back on.

title: Does an adequate job
text:
The product lives up to its claims. No greasy residue. No bad, strong chemical smell.

I guess I was expecting it to make my vinyl shine similar to products like Armour All but without the greasyness and smell. This it did not do. The vinyl is clean but dull after applying this solution.

So depends what you are looking for as to whether this product will wow you.

title: Works well, doesn’t seal
text: This ashtray works great outdoors. The spring on the clamp is nice and strong, and you can clip onto whatever you have handy. If you want to use it in your car, be aware that although it has a lid, it doesn’t seal, so the smells can still escape.

title: No issues at all
text: These were easy to install and work great on my 2011 Chevy Impala. I’m interested to see how they do when the weather gets hot, but so far they’ve been great.

title: Nice and bright
text: Put these on a 2011 Chevy Impala. Nice upgrade!

title: A Whole New Experience
text:
Installed these on my 2011 Impala and it’s like a whole new experience at night. LED lights are just leaps and bounds more effective than halogen. I used to buy the blue tinted halogen bulbs for a whiter light, but I don’t know why I didn’t take the leap earlier.

The only thing that I worry about is proper heat dissipation since the headlight assemblies are sealed up as tight as a drum. Time will tell on this, but I think it’s going to be ok.

title: Much better than my old ones
text: I live out in the country, so I spend plenty of time driving on unlit country roads. These LED headlights are SO much better than my old headlights on 2004 Suburban. I can see much farther ahead, and further side to side as well. They were easy to install, too. I don’t have any idea how long they will last, but I can say that I like them!

title: Awesome, just don’t hit the flashlight by mistake
text: This thing is awesome. It holds a lot of charge and functions as a power bank as well as a car jumper. It has a compass, which works great. It also has a flashlight, which is also really handy. The only slight problem is that it’s possible to hit the flashlight button by mistake. Apparently one of us did that when putting the device away, and the flashlight stayed on for a really long time and drained the battery. That would be super annoying if you needed it to jump your car and it was run down. So just be careful with the flashlight switch.

title: Not the sturdiest, but does the job
text: I got this organizer to put behind the back row seat of my 2004 Suburban, and it works just fine there, and helps to organize our cargo space. It doesn’t come with any instructions, but it’s pretty self-explanatory. I’m glad it comes with adhesive Velcro strips; they hold it in place to keep it from swinging around as you drive, but it’s easy to remove the organizer if you want to. The only real drawback that I can see is the quality of the materials. They are not particularly sturdy. The plastic clasps that clip around the headrests are really thin and would probably break pretty easily, especially if you were taking the organizer off and on regularly. The cloth material of the organizer itself is ok, but again not super thick or reinforced. But it does get the job done, so it could be a legitimate budget option, if the price is right.

title: Easily stolen.
text: Not worth it. People stole both of them. Cute idea though.

title: Cute and practical
text: It's so cute and I use it more than I imagined I would!

title: Not worth $10 at all. Broke!
text: Broke right away. Sticks out and made cheaply.

title: Nice build quality and a useful design
text:
I'm impressed with the build quality of this cargo retriever. The specs state that it's strong enough to withstand 100 pounds, which seems to be a pretty reasonable claim. I used it to pull a 60 pound sack of concrete mix and it felt more than secure enough in use.

The pole is metal (feels like aluminum) with a friction ring to adjust the length. The friction ring holds pretty well and is easy to adjust to length. The hook is steel and has a thick plastic coating on the hook end that does a good job of protecting the bed paint.

The hook attachment can be removed and replaced with a brush. The brush is quite stiff -- it's not something I'd use on paint, but it's fine for sweeping out the bed. I can see it being useful, but I would have preferred another hook in a different size or angle rather than a brush (I prefer to use a leaf blower for bed cleaning). It comes with a decent quality storage sack which is nice for keeping all the items together and neatly stowed.

All in all, a very handy item to have that's built strong enough to last a good amount of time. Five stars.

title: Some useful items but very low-end packaging/presentation
text:
Gift sets are never a good value but offer the benefit of nice presentation and packaging. This "hangover recovery" kit falls well short of the mark when it comes to presentation. All of the items are jumbled together in a cheap clear plastic sack. It looks very much like something you'd find at the checkout counter at the Dollar Store.

The items themselves are not bad. Most are useful and are name brands. Expiration dates for the meds are reasonable (the package I received in Nov 2022 had expiration dates of 10/23 for the Advil and 3/25 for the Alka Seltzer). The items that stuck out as being less useful/lower quality are the sewing kit (very cheap and of little value) and the lip balm (poor quality and hard to use).

This might make for a nice tongue-in-cheek type of party favor if it had a presentation that was on-par with the high price. Granted, you could repackage the items into nicer gift sacks/small gift boxes, but given the price point, that's something the manufacturer should have done. The embarrassingly cheap packaging/presentation makes this a 1.5 star product at best.

title: Works great in a Subaru
text: I've been using Pennzoil for decades in all my cars, and have never been disappointed in the performance or the value compared with other brands. This 0W-20 synthetic has been working great in my Subaru. No complaints at all with performance, and a very good value for the price. Five stars.

title: Decent performance; lots of suds; very nice scent; quite pricey
text:
This is a decent performing car wash. It's reasonably thick, and provides more than ample suds. It did a fine job cleaning, and didn't leave any haze or residue behind. I found the apple scent unusual and rather enjoyable compared with how car soap typically smells. It's also a distinctive light green color. Granted that has nothing to do with how well it works, but it's different. The soap is made in the US.

While the performance is fine, the price per ounce is quite steep compared with other brands, even major brand name brands of car wash soap. Given that the performance, while certainly adequate, was not better than other soaps I've used, one star down for value.

title: Good build quality; nice design; accurate
text:
I'm very pleased with this tire pressure gauge. It's well made, with good quality connectors, chuck, and tubing. The protective case around the gauge is helpful for keeping the bumps from harming the gauge. The dial is pretty easy to read, although it would have been nice if it were just a bit larger so my old eyes could see it better.

It retains the reading until the bleed valve is pressed, which is a very helpful feature. I also like that the chuck and the connector to the gauge rotate, so it's easy to position it regardless of where the tire stem is.

Accuracy appears to be spot on. It gives me the same reading (less than a pound variation) with my other gauges, which I know to be accurate.

No complaints -- it's well made, works great, is easy to use and a good value for the price. Five stars.

title: Very easy to use; great shine; does not appear to be all that durable in terms of protection
text:
This is a very easy -- and probably the easiest -- way to put a great shine on your car. Just spray, wipe, and lightly buff with a dry towel. Doing a compact size car takes very little time. Just be sure to have a few good microfiber towels on hand. The wipe down towel will work even if it gets damp from the spray, but the buff towel needs to be perfectly dry to prevent streaking.

The shine it leaves is excellent. My car is black, and the depth of the shine really impressed me. Considering how little effort I put in makes it even more impressive in terms of how it looks.

While the finish feels very smooth and slippery right after application, it doesn't last long. A good paste wax shine comes back after the car is washed, but this shine doesn't last after a wash. That makes me think this is not providing a whole lot of protection to the finish compared with a conventional wax.

On the other hand, the time it takes to "wax" my car with this spray is probably a tenth of the time it takes to use a conventional wax, so re-applying it more often is not a major task.

Five stars for the ease of use and shine; three stars for durability/protection. Overall rating of 4 stars. It's the easiest way I've come across so far to get a deep, rich shine without breaking a sweat.

title: Ultra gentle polishing compound; not much for scratch removal but good for other purposes
text:
This is a gentle polishing compound. It's a medium-thick liquid that's easy to work with. It comes with a synthetic sponge applicator (not great but usable) and a microfiber polishing cloth (too thin to be effective). It's used much like any polishing compound: apply to a cool surface out of the sun, polish with overlapping circular motions, then buff off with a microfiber cloth (of better quality than the one provided). It has a light odor that is not objectionable.

It does a decent job on light issues such as water spots. It doesn't take a lot of elbow grease to get results and it buffs off fairly easily. It can also handle light swirl marks decently well. For anything more significant it's not effective. A more accurate description of this product would remove any reference to scratch removal and concentrate on what it can do: water spots, light swirl marks and other superficial finish issues.

The cost is not unreasonable compared with similar products, but it's not a bargain either.

While this didn't impress me with superlative performance, it wasn't terrible either. I see it as an average (3 star) performer.

title: Works great for car interiors; easy to reach all spots
text:
I'm pleased with this window cleaning kit. It's ideal for car interiors since the angular head makes it easy to reach all areas of the windshield. It's all plastic, but adequately sturdy for home use. The handle is comfortable and is nicely padded with foam so it's easy to maintain a good grip.

It comes with 2 terry-like cleaning covers and 1 polishing cover. I use the terry ones most of the time since they work well to get the glass clean. The covers have an elastic hem that keeps them firmly attached to the pad. They are easy to wash (I wash mine by hand with a little dishwashing soap, but they can be machine washed). It's best to let them air dry to keep the elastic in good shape.

It also comes with a small spray bottle. It's OK, but not all that impressive in terms of build quality.

The end of the handle has a screw-on cap with a loop so you can hang this on a wall.
