title: Versatile
text: This set was purchased on a whim.  I liked the price, and I know I will soon need to mount an LED bar on either a roof rack or bumper bar.  Brackets are solid and strong.  The included rubber tube mounts are great for multiple sizes of tubes.  I plan to use this on a roof mounted basket for an LED light bar.

title: Volvo Plate Frame - Look up pictures for 9154456
text:
Product is exactly what is says it is. License plate mounting frame. Volvo cars have an odd mount spacing for US plates, and need to use this device. I like the concept but not the application.
Bracket design is flawed. One side is taller than the other, but a license plate is flat. The picture is not exactly what I received - but the description matches perfectly. I should have done a little more research, and can blame no one but myself.

Installed 2001 Volvo S80. Had to put in some spacers on the short side to lift the plate for a better fit , but not too much or the nuts would not have any threads to connect. I cannot think of any US license plate that would fit this bracket without damage.

This amazon item came with mounting nuts. I painted the bracket and nuts black.

title: Philips 194 LED White
text:
Perfect lamp for the job. 194 socket (12961 lamp) is very bright and clean. 6000K matches other high quality lamps of the same color.

Installed 2001 Volvo S80. Rear door interior lights, license plate, high-beam marker, front marker, side indicator.

title: Amber 194 LED
text:
Perfect wedge lamps. marker, indicator, foot well, license plate, etc. Sylvania 194 LED is very good.

Installed 2001 Volvo S80. Side marker, side indicator, high-beam marker. Often had to rotate lamp 180 degrees but install was easy.

title: Nice LED interior lighting
text:
Nice LED interior lighting. Bright and dim as the stock incandescent would, but so much better! Easy install. Make sure to aim the the correct way if your interior lighting is designed to cover more than just straight down. Light output is fantastic!

Installed in 2001 Volvo S80.

Only complaint: not really 6000K color. Much more blue color than 6000K, but the light output is fantastic.

title: Bright Amber 7507, be ready to install resistors
text:
Fantastic LED light in all directions. Amber color - perfect for indicator. Sadly not Canbus error free, and caused hyperflash.

Installed 2001 Volvo S80. Front Indicators. Sad to report Canbus errors and Hyperflash. I do not have the option for electronic flash or resistors.

Really bright, fantastic light output.

title: Awesome, but not for Volvo
text:
Great Lamps for indicator install. Fit in socket perfectly, very clean bright light.

Installed in 2001 Volvo S80. With engine off they worked perfectly. With engine on, they reported errors and hyper-flash.

I wanted to love these, but sadly my Volvo does not.

title: Bright, RED, LED - Not Canbus
text:
Great lamps fit 1156 and are RED LED. Better light than incandescent - by far. Clear, fast, bright. At the time of purchase I am certain these were listed as Canbus - no error. This is not the case for these lamps - so if you have a Canbus system - do not purchase these. Quick, easy install.

Installed in 2001 Volvo S80 - error for every location installed accept reverse - red is not useful for reverse. I could use them if my warning system did not display an error for each LED installed (was going to use all 10).

title: Great bright light for the price
text: Good lamps for my interior.  Dim to full with door unlock, and dim down to off with door lock.  These are in my foot wells and trunk factory lighting locations.  They work well, have plenty of light.  Much better than stock incandescent and the price was good.  I do not think they are an actual 6000K color, as I also have 2 other brands that are much more consistent.  The color would not be an issue if these lamps were not near the others.

title: Yellow H1 lamps - great for factory fog replacement
text: Installed in my 2001 Volvo S80.  Perfect fit in the stock housing.  Light pattern is the same as stock - but Yellow.  I do not use them often, but I wanted my factory fog lights to be yellow.  Was hoping these would be the same yellow/amber as my LED markers/LED high beam markers/LED indicators - not the case.  I do like them as factory replacements.

title: Great jumper cables for the price.  Not "all copper" wire.
text:
Strong clamps with good teeth.
Compared to some other #4, this is smaller on the gauge. The wire left plenty of space inside some 4 AWG connectors I crimped for cable quick connects.
The description says "All Copper" but is not correct, it is plated copper wire.
The insulation is very thick and appears to be very good.
I like the clamps - they are strong, the teeth are very good on both sides of the clamp, with an extended clamp on one side for the battery terminal.

Great clamps, price-appropriate wire, good insulation. I would rather have purchased real "all copper" wire, but this will do for now.

Pictures, the black/red vs a true 4 AWG wire - from left to right. Also, notice the color - true copper (right side) is copper ALL the way through, but you can see the ends of the black/red are silver. Not sure the conductor used here.

title: Well built quick connect kit
text:
Quick disconnect at a great price.
I connected 4 AWG wire, not sure how you could properly connect 2 AWG. I used a crimper and the connection is very solid. The aluminum posts do make a very good connection - very tight and solid. I base my amperage usage on the wire used - so taking 4 AWG I am sure these will preform to my needs.
I purchased 2 sets, so I could have one in the rear for my air compressor and one in the front for my jumper cables.
Again, the connection is very solid. The build quality seems sound. I like the rubber caps - not sure if I'll use them but they do fit well.

title: WeatherTech - high quality!
text:
WeatherTech!
Very nice shade. Quality and build are fantastic. The outside edges are sewn very well and do not seem like they will fall apart. One side is reflective, the other is absorbing - silver/black - for summer/winter applications.
Fit is exact - as all WeatherTech products are known to be.
Durable - as WeatherTech products are known to be.
I like the fit - full windshield - and core strength it has.
The windshield is fully covered now - I had to get a different phone holder, and take down my radar detector during the day (I already do this).
The only issues:
1. It is large and rolls up - so I put it on the back seat. Not really easy to store. Sure, I could put in the the back, but then I have to actually put it in the back, and get it out when I need it. Rear seat is fine for now.
2. The fit is great to the windshield - but my rear view mirror requires me to curl the top under in order to get behind. I am very concerned the shade material will fail at this application point, and there is no other way for me to install it. This is the reason for the 4-star. Otherwise it would rate 5-star.

Otherwise - Fantastic shade - love it. I drive 2000 Nissan Pathfinder - with the factory temp/compass overhead console.

title: Satisfied customer
text:
Chemical Guys! Great soap, I use a hose powered foamer and this stuff comes out in suds! Easy clean and rinses clean. Even though it states is PH balanced and will not leave water spots... I'd recommend against washing in direct sun. If you end up with some water spots though, use a drying Microfiber towel over the surface - slightly damp - and they should come right off.
I drive a BLACK suv, and this soap works very well for me. Rinses and I am satisfied.

I could show you a picture of a clean vehicle, but that would only tell you I take care of my paint.
Great soap, plenty of foam, rinses clean. Using the proper amount, every 2 weeks I wash 2-3 SUVs and still have a half gallon remaining - should last me about a year.

title: Does the job, but you may need to modify them.
text:
This kit works.
Strong brackets and solid welds.
I purchased it for install on my factory rails with a surco rack. My factory rails are not exactly flat on the top, nor are they exactly parallel with the bar on the surco rack. This channel adapter must be a "universal" mount as it does not fit the exact angle of my rails.

1. Used fender washers to space the mounting brackets for the angle of my roof rails
2. Had to use longer bolts - as the supplied ones are not long enough for my factory rails.
I had some stainless 10mm hex 6x16 bolts that fit perfectly. Otherwise I would have had to go to my hardware store for bolts.

Picture shows the fender washers used to force the adapter past the flat angle to fit with my rails.

I drive a 2000 Nissan pathfinder - factory rails. same fit 1996 - 2004 make/model

title: Very happy with this wire.
text:
WIRE! So, what can I say here about wire you do not know already:
1. True 4 gauge - I do believe this to be true. Satisfied customer here. Very tight fit in the 4 AWG fuse holder.
2. Red, but kind of translucent - the wire is slightly visible through the coating.
3. Thick coating - very durable
4. Flexible - much more flexible than I expected from a fine strand wire.

End: Buy this wire if you need 4 AWG Red.

Pictures: First is this #4 vs standard #2 welding cable, and standard #4 copper. Second is beside the existing #4 that was replaced by this wire. Fantastic wire to buy.

title: Great light in a small package and a low price
text:
Great light in a small package and a low price.
I purchased this light and installed on my roof rack as a backup light. Alone, it does a fantastic job. I will likely purchase more of these for side/rock lights.
Bracket easy to connect to unit and mount to a flat surface. Adjust-ability with the mount is enough, 180 deg rotation. Wire very flexible and long enough to make connections for extension to junction box.

Update: Purchased a 2-pack and am happy with the light output. Offset rear for slight side lighting.
Previously single unit installed is working like it was when new. No leaking at all and it is exposed directly to the elements.

Paint surface suffering - gloss black is now a flat/matte black from UV rays and poor quality paint. Not a complaint - and does not diminish usefulness of item (leaving at 5 stars). No rust, no problems. Great lights!

title: This set is fantastic. The install was very easy
text:
I was skeptical based on the price, but with as many positive reviews I figured I didn't have much to lose. This set is fantastic. The install was very easy. I painted the shrouds and the internal parts of my lamps to match. Easy to fit and adjust.
This kit looked to me like another name brand projector kit available online. This kit includes the shrouds - not that I really cared, but without them it would look odd.
Fantastic kit, easy to install, perfect price. WIN. Get this if you are doing your first retrofit, then buy it again for the next job - I know I will.

title: and they work great! No dead units in this package
text: Installed in instrument cluster.  I used them for direct lights, not for cluster flood.  Replaced all the warning lamps, and they work great!  No dead units in this package.  Bright red, works great behind red lens units - would not recommend them behind green (indicator) or other lenses.  I bought them just for my warning lights - and they work fantastically!

title: Back to Factory new feel
text: Purchased to replace original struts in year 2000 Nissan Pathfinder.  Fantastic replacement - just like original feel.  I did drive the vehicle when it was new - the control has been returned - as both the stock struts were completely blown.

title: Back to Factory new feel

One was removed from the box and is dirty - the other is still in the box - but I do not think I can return them.  I am sure it is an "OK" product, but in this case - a failure.

Attempted install on 2000 Nissan Pathfinder.

title: More Purple than I expected or wanted
text:
This color is not what I expected. Turquoise/Silver yes, and a little bit of purple in some instructional online videos yes, but not as much purple as I ended up having.
My wheel spray:
Front wheels with 2 layers of gray, 2 layers of black, and 3 layers of Turquoise/Silver.
Rear wheels with 4 layers of black, and 3 layers of Turquoise/Silver.
This product is recommended to coat over existing layers - and did very well.
I hope the pictures will help you understand how much purple I had in view on the wheels. I peeled it off after 4 days - it was too much purple for me.

title: Putco WIN! This is THE LED replacement!
text:
Big fan of these LED units. Granted the are not DOT approved for use, they do work much better than many other brands. I am very satisfied with these over the course of time I have had them installed. Heat is not an issue as of yet, and the light output is much cleaner than the stock incandescent lamp.
Four stars based not on performance but on cost. Also, wish they could be DOT approved, but not a factor I really am concerned about.
Installed for longer than a month, very pleased. Attached photos show the Putco LED on the left, and stock incandescent on the right. One picture is running light, other is caught with emergency flashers. Putco LED out performs the stock incandescent during direct daylight situations.
I have tried many other LED options and the Putco wins hands down!
Installed in 2000 Nissan Pathfinder.

title: Not for 2000 Nissan R50 Pathfinder
text: Did not install on 2000 Nissan R50 Pathfinder.  I wanted to like this product, I wanted to install it and enjoy the benefits.  It does not fit 2000 Nissan  R50 Pathfinder engine intake.  I attempted to install the elbow backwards, but no matter what I did, the filter would end up occupying the same space as the radiator.  Fantastic product by a fantastic company, just does not fit my vehicle.

title: Thank you PHILIPS!
text: Installed on 2000 Nissan R50 Pathfinder.  Bloody Fantastic! Finally - a DOT approved LED I can use in my car.  Granted - my car is not on the Philips list of approved vehicles (they are all new models and very expensive) but it does work just fantastically.  I have to say they are not considerably brighter than my stock incandescent, but they react immediately and do not have those bright spots like the cheap LEDs or even some of the really expensive ones.  I have clear lenses over these and the red is perfect!

title: Cabin Air Filter - Carbon Activated
text:
Fresh air, doesn't stink, and I do not notice any air flow issues. I modified my airbox to fit these as my 2000 Nissan Pathfinder SE did not come equipped with the cabin air filter option.
IT is a 2 pack, they slide into the slot as designed, and the metal clip holds the bottom one in place, as the bottom one holds the top one in place.

title: Unfortunate experience LED taillight
text: I also have had about the same experience as Matthew.  I special ordered these pilot LEDs at my local Autozone.  Seemed great at first, but I always drive with my running or headlight on.  About a week after install I noticed when I hit my brakes all my other lights came on - stereo lights also.  Rotating the lamps did not help, back to incandescent until I get something that works.  Special order and used, so I can't take them back.

title: Bumper cover replacement for 2000 nissan r50 pathfinder
text: Worked perfectly for me.  Primered with a few scuffs as shipping has a tendency to do, but as a primered bumper that will be painted, it was exactly what I needed.  Plastic tabs on the bottom side are fexible - I did not expect this.  The ends were just slightly wider than my mounts, but flexed in perfectly.  Good fit, just like original, foglights and caps no problem.  Save your original metal clips - they will be needed.  I would also recommend new plastic clips, I broke most of them removing the old bumper.  Painted it, mounted it, and am very happy.

title: Dim and a bit blue
text: Diodes work and produce light.  Looks whitish, but behind instrument panel is very dim and a bit blue.  Less light than the blue ones they replaced.  Not very bright, not a great white (for me), and not much lateral light.  They are ok, but I will be replacing them as soon as new ones arrive.

title: Nice T5 Blue LED lamps
text:
These T5 LEDS are fine. If you are looking to actually see your gauges, I'd not recommend these. I used one in my ash try light and it worked perfectly, but they were not good (bright enough) in my HVAC or dash cluster. I had hoped to match them to my blue stereo lights, but I'm guessing the stereo is the problem here. Great straight on for light, but not so much for lateral dispersion.

2000 Nissan Pathfinder R50.

title: Works, but is not properly designed
text:
Installation kit is not actually a kit as much as a trim ring. Unfortunately, as designed to attach to a double din stereo, it can only rest in place in my Pathfinder. As the brackets are designed with tapered screws and specific brackets, this device only rests in place and is held (loose) by the bezel when re-installed. Be careful to not let it pop out through the bezel, as you re-attach. Should be titled "trim ring" not install kit. It works to keep you from seeing the gap into the hvac system so it will stay, but I figured there would be a better fitting/more secure ring out there.

2000 Nissan Pathfinder R50.

title: T5 SMD LED Wedges
text:
Product works as described. Bright and white light with excellent coverage. I had to tighten my lamp holders just a little to keep these wedges in, as they are thinner than a normal incandescent - but only by a little bit. Polarity does matter with these, I have not tested dimming capabilities.

The short: Good lamps, good buy.

title: T10 White SMD LED 194 WIN!
text:
I do love these wedge lamps. LED at it's best in my opinion. I replaced some gauge back lights - stock incandescent, with these LED wedges, and LOVE IT! SO bright - and they do dim - somewhat. Tested all 10 in my pack, yes, polarity is important, and they all worked perfectly. My instrument cluster never looked so fantastic! Also, replaced a few license plate lamps with these wedges and am very pleased. They work in my corner markers and my aftermarket side markers as well. If your mounting location is close to the lens, they do look, a little odd, but the light spread is plenty for any mounting location.

The short: Buy these wedges, install them, and Love them!

title: T5 LED mini-wedge
text: Fantastic little LEDs.  Bright as one would expect, Just a little loose in the bases - but not enough to fall out.  They do dim a little, not as much as the stock incandescent, but my issue was the stock light was not bright enough so this is not going to be an issue.  Polarity is an issue - as expected with LEDs - so keep that in mind when installing.  I will need more... so at least I know which ones I will be buying in the future.  LEDwholesalers For The Win!

title: lift support
text: Easy install clips.  much better than looking for the (oem) factory replacement.  Exact part numbers for my vehicle had different lifts for both left and right.  All my local stores were out - and their warehouses - of one side.  This option looked good, and indeed was just what I needed.  Fast install, they work better than I ever expected.  Factory ones were 6 years old and hardly lifted the gate to 3/4.  These are so good, my wife has a difficult time closing the liftgate.

title: 5-SMD White High Power LED
text: Honestly the best I've used.  Insane output from these SMD LEDs.  Installed over license plate with a downward light angle.  They light up the area behind the vehicle almost as well as my backup lights, but only about 3-4 ft from the rear.  I replaced a side marker light with these as well (behind an amber lens) and the increased output is very noticable at night.

title: Air Filter
text: What can I say, ACDelco - original part.  Great price, install was easy.  Check Engine light came on the day after I installed it - but I hear that is common.  Independant testing rated this better - for particle protection - than K&N, so I'm good with it.

text:
I have tried different saddle soaps, tack restorers, etc and this little jar is one of the best leather care products I have used for my saddles and tack. I had just acquired a beautiful old Aussie stock saddle that must be at least 40 years of age and highly abused with dirt, mold, and living in a damp barn and garage. I thought after reading the reviews that I would try this product and it does not disappoint. I cleaned the saddle with a spray saddle soap to get the suface dirt off and then applied the product and I was amazed how well it went on as far as easy application and the results. The stirrup leather, espeically, looked like they were going to just crimble, and the product just seeped into the old leather and just restored the straps beautifully. Frankly, I was amzed how the saddle came to life. Once I finish her, I will post a photo and I cannot believe it is the same saddle.

I do recommend Leather Milk but it is expensive though a very good product. But, for the money and ease of use, this little black jar of wonder works like a champ.

title: Stable, amazing quality for the price!
text:
Just one word to describe this: Wow!

Technology sure has come along. I was looking for some cheap weekend entertainment so I found the cheapest FPV drone I could find and ended up with this on my porch. The box and packaging alone seemed to be worth the total cost, so I was nervous what I had gotten into. I opened the box and out came the remote and drone.

The remote has a slight grippy feel to it. There are no markings on the inner buttons, but the instructions tell you what does what. I had a fine tip sharpie and marked my own markings on the buttons to help me in a moment of panic. The app is very easy to use, I just turn on the drone, connect to the wifi, then start the app. The best part of the controller that makes it easy to fly is the left joystick height adjustment. Most remotes are loose and it is very hard to hold stable height. This remote snaps to the center after pushing it up or down, bumping the drone height up or down when pushed.

The drone itself: Good quality! The drone quality, after getting this far for the price I paid, is very good. I put the bumpers on it and flew it around the house. It had some crashes but nothing broke! I played with the flip feature, and love the FPV option as it makes it so much more fun to fly. To be honest I could not get the one touch return to home to work. I think it may fly towards the controller when the button is pushed but I was in an enclosed space and could not fully test it. Battery life was decent, a little less than 10 minutes, which is impressive for the quick charge time. I am impressed with how stable it is after doing a little bit of trimming on the controls. The top portion comes off, and I'm sure you could spray paint any color you wanted on top. The 2 options at the time of my purchase was black and white. I love how the legs fold toward the body to make it super easy to transport and store, preventing damage and bent propellers.

Overall: GREAT DRONE! Fun to play with, WAY above what I expected for the price. A couple friends have seen what it can do and were so impressed they couldn't help but get one for themself or their kid.

title: Made in China.  Does not fit.  Too short.
text:
Everything looked wonderful and beautiful! My original truck bed is breaking down so that is why I bought this. I was very excited to install it on my 2013 Toyota Tacoma double cab. I laid it out at the front end of the truck bed frame near the back windows. I unbuckled and opened the trifold all the way out...I was like, it is not covering all the way to the tailgate?? I looked at the front end again...then back to the tailgate. TOO SHORT!!!

I have a 5 ft truck bed and it matches the description for this item. However, the manufacturers of this DID NOT consider the extra length needed to be able to cover the frame on both ends. Plus, when people say 5ft bed, it doesn't necessarily mean exactly 5ft, just like when people talk about 2x4x8 wood, its actually 1.5x3.5x8ish wood.

My original truck bed cover is actually 63.5 inches long--an extra 3.5 inches as needed to cover the frame. Theirs is exactly 5 ft (60 inches) and doesn't even close off the frame.

I thought, maybe there are other truck bed lengths so I googled it up. Here are the measurements:
2001-2004
short bed-60.25 inches
long bed-73.49 inches

2005-2015
short bed-61 inches
long bed-73.88 inches

With that said, an exactly 5ft cover still wouldn't even touch the frame.

This truck bed cover is Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon.

title: Made in China. You would be well advised to consider a hard carrier.
text:
The pictures are a bit deceiving on this listing. It almost looks like this is a hard case sort of carrier, but it's not. Unless you packet full and smooth out all the edges, it will never look like the pictures.

Pros: I loved that it gave me plenty of space to store my things, than being cramped in the car on a family trip during the holidays. It is made of double sided waterproof pvc and covers the zipped area to ensure rain doesn’t get through the zippers.

Cons: The cargo bag is not like what is pictured for a few reasons:
a. Your bag will look like the picture only if it is perfectly full. The picture does not show the ends of the straps dangling. If your bag is not FULL, then it will sag and you will have to really pull the straps all the way, resulting in a 6 really long straps dangling. I had to pull all 6 over and tie them on top.
b. With the sun coming up and down while driving, the shadow reflection of the straps flapping around on top of the car was distracting.
c. After 15 minutes, I noticed 1 of the buckles came loose, it is possible that it wasn’t completely buckled. I didn’t have any problems afterwards. Make sure it is completely buckled.
d. Once I arrived at my destination, I had to untie the long straps loosen then zip it open.
e. Zipping open and close around the hard corners was a struggle. It needs to have a curved corner design for the zipper like with backpacks.
The straps that go across the top needs to have another set of buckle on top so it will allow you to shorten the entire strap as needed before strapping to the vehicle.
If you really need this, order a smaller one so the dangling straps will be shorter.

I don’t think it is worth 90 bucks for all this trouble. I would prefer pay for a hard cargo that is securely hooked to the vehicle without the excessive straps.

The cables are advertised to handle 800amp peak current, but I do not have the infrastructure to test this peak. It is also designed only for 12v vehicle batteries and gas or diesel engines smaller than 7.5L. The 25 foot jumpers are probably too long for most instances, but in those rare instances when the two cars can't get very close these will be a lifesaver. Also, with the 800amp peak current for gas or diesel engines below 7.5L these cables will more than cover most vehicles on the road from small compact vehicles to SUVs/vans.

In addition to the cables, I received a pair of gloves with rubber grips, a wire brush to scrub corroded battery terminals and a flat 20in by 20in carrying case with a pull tie.

Overall, these may be longer and more powerful for most situations, but by having the extra length (25ft) will allow some additional distance between the two vehicles. Also, the lower gauge and higher peak amp (800) means these cables will be good for any vehicle I would be driving.

text: I like the gallon size of this cleaner and the fact that it is a concentrate. I filled my wash bucket up about half way full of water and then poured in a couple of capfuls of the detergent. Before I could get dried off it made water spots. The spots came off as soon as I went over them with my shammy cloth, but I would prefer to do my own waxing and not have it in the soap. It does a great job of cleaning, but you definitely cannot let your vehicle air dry.

title: Super easy to use!
text: This product is specifically made for motorcycles, but I use it on my car. It can be used on any painted, chrome, fiberglass, or metal surface. It goes on like a liquid wax which I love. This is the ideal way to spruce up the finish on your vehicle without spending the entire day to make it look good. After washing and drying my car I use this STAR BRITE product and it looks freshly waxed in half the time. I hold the bottle in one hand and rub it in with the other. Fast and easy. It will also remove stubborn bugs or other “stuff” that ends up on your car or bike. I have found the STAR BRITE product to be of superior quality and will be using for many years to come.

title: Expensive for just one bottle, which may not be enough to get the job done
text: This product advertises itself as a “speed detailer” for RV’s to be used in-between waxing. But it is a quick and easy way to touch up your boat or in my case, your car as well. It comes in a bottle with the sprayer separate, which I like. Because it is a liquid wax it goes on very easy. I spray with one hand and rub it in with the other. It is very easy to apply, dries fast, and rubs off easily.  Be sure to apply to a clean, dry vehicle. I always wax my car in the shade. The other great thing about this product is the UV protection that it offers for your RV, boat, or car. The STAR BRIGHT products are very versatile and cost about the same as other similar products. I really like the ease and convenience of these product.  My only “issue” is at the current price of over twenty bucks for one small bottle, which will not even come close to being enough for an entire RV, it’s quite expensive.

title: You'll need a 2nd package for ATV's
text: These tie downs come two to a package and are made to secure a motorcycle or ATV to a trailer. I have used them for both. If you are going to use them for the ATV an additional package will need to be purchased. The ATV needs to have 4 straps to properly secure it. I attend some motorcycle events and like to trailer them because my wife cannot ride long distances. I have used the tie downs straps to secure the bikes without any issues. The hooks are rubber coated so they don't scratch your bike or the trailer. These have a built-in loop that gives a tie extension that also prevents marring of paint and chrome finishes. To increase the tension pull the webbing and set to desired tension. There is a "PRESS" button that will release the lever when you are ready to unhitch your bike or ATV. They are simple and easy to use. Just a word of caution, they are recommended for weights up to 500 lbs. Be sure to use additional ones for cargo that weighs more than that.

title: Not only for motorcycles
text: The ratchet tie downs to me are the simplest and easiest to use, they are also work the best. They are made for large capacity hauling like motorcycles and ATV's but I use them for everything under the sun. I like antiques and have purchased many large pieces for my home. I have used the ratchet tie downs to secure everything from an armoire , to chest of drawers, and desk. I moved my son back and forth from college every spring and fall and could not have done it without the ratchet tie downs. They have rubber coated hooks that attached to the truck, so they don't scratch your truck or furniture (or whatever you are moving). To tighten the webbing, pump the ratchet handle. There is a press-release button on the side to loosen it back up.  The tighter you make the webbing, the more difficult it is to press the release button. These ratchet tie downs are handy to have and can be used for many different purposes.

title: Nice cover overall
text: We have a 1969 Mustang Cobra.  We have purchased many car covers over the years to keep this “baby” safe and protected (while sitting inside the garage) and they eventually tear and are ill-fitting. This is by far the nicest car cover the Mustang has been adorned with.  I was expecting a much heavier cover considering the soft fleece interior lining and the 6 layers of protection. It was easy to fit over the car, but had little room remaining. There are reflectors on the corners that keep me from bumping into the car at night. I most definitely like that! It has front and back straps to keep the cover in place. This is a “blue ribbon” cover and the nicest one our car has ever had.  It’s Made in China, so a bit pricey at the current price of just under seventy-five bucks, but again I’m quite happy with it.

title: Would have preferred a USB plug
text:
The cooling fan is small and does not put out a lot of air, but it is enough so that he feels more comfortable. It has a strap that slides down over the seat and is very easy to install. You just plug it into the cigarette lighter for power and it has an on and off switch. The mesh design adds additional support and comfort. It has Velcro strips that are used for any necessary adjustments making it easy and simple. It has a slight noise, but within minutes of turning on the radio I did not notice it anymore. This product is not going to keep you super cool, but the fan does feel good blowing on your back.

Because everyone has cell phones and other devices in their cars these days, it would have been nice if this item had a USB plug instead.

title: Handy little gadget
text: This charger comes in a quality casing with a black and red battery clamp. It can be used on the battery inside the car or on a battery that has been removed from the vehicle.  It also comes with O-rings connections for long term charging. Additionally, it has a DC plug for the inside of your car which I think is a great option. There is a protective coating that keeps dirt and moisture out.  The charger will shut off after the battery is fully charged. It does make a low humming sound, but I use it in the garage area so that is not a draw back. It is a good charger for the price and functions great as a battery maintainer for my lawnmower.

title: Great product at a reasonable price

It does a good job of dissolving goop that might have built-up.  It takes about five minutes or so to dry.  I haven’t seen better gas mileage, but I really wasn’t expecting that.  So far it’s working for me without any issues.  Really nice product.

title: Check the guide first.
text: First, if you need to know which bulb you need, you need to do an online search for “Sylvania's Automotive Bulb Replacement Guide”.  It will walk you through which bulb you need for what you need to replace.  You don’t simply want to “guess”.  These LED lights are great though.  They use less power, which has saved my batter from going dead once when I left an overhead light on.  They are also affordable, and are supposed to last for the life of your car. . . which is quite nice.

title: High-Quality Ladder Rack
text: This is a VERY sturdy rack.  The rack itself weighs over fifty pounds, so you know that it’s going to be able to carry / hold a lot of weight.  The listing shows it will hold 250 pounds.  It’s certainly easy to install..  . BUT. . . it may not work for trucks with bed liners, without some modifications.  If you have such a truck, you may want to check with TracRac before purchasing, just to see if it’s going to work for you.  Depending upon your ladders, it’s probably only going to hold one.  The cost is a bit high, but it’s a very sturdy / quality product, so you’ll be happy with your purchase.

title: A bit pricey, but I like it

text: We have a lot of toys around here and needed a good, dependable charger on hand. The cables are included so you can use this device in other countries, which is great for people that travel. The long needle nose clips are really nice and clip onto any terminal size. Those buttons that scared me at first make it really easy to change to the appropriate voltage. I really like the diagnostics and its ability to detect a battery so low that any other charger would say it was dead. My husband was going to order another motorcycle battery but this charger brought it back to life. This is designed for pros but it is a must have in our garage.

title: Must have on car trips
text: This device is a total lifesaver on car trips. Never again will I have to listen to constant complaints from the backseat because a game system or laptop is out of battery. It’s very convenient to have and I leave it in the car all the time. It works great for powering a hair dryer if you’re running late or keeping devices that need a typical 110 outlet charged/running. It also works great for running a car vacuum or spot cleaner so I don’t have to stretch an extension cord all the way outside. I’m happy I’ll have this for the handful of road trips we have coming up this summer. Anything that makes life this easy in the car gets a top recommendation from me.

title: Easy to use spray gun system gives professional results
text: I have watched my dad paint a couple cars and it seemed like such a hassle because he had to do so much cleanup and soaking and switching between colors was a nightmare. Everything you need to get started is in this kit short of paint and an air compressor. The system uses disposable cups and changeable nozzles so you can quickly switch between colors. The design is wonderful. You don’t end up with a bunch of paint clogging your spray gun. There are several different nozzle sizes to accommodate different types of paint. While it is for auto use, I think it could work well for other applications. We’ve used it to touch up a few things and the results are great. My husband and father in law have been working on a kit car that will need to be painted soon. I’m excited to see how well this gun does on a full paint job. Highly recommend!

title: Solid, sturdy, well done step
text:
This Evcitn Safety RV Steps, Adjustable and Folding RV Step is well done with good materials and a solid and sturdy surface upon which to stand. We are very pleased.

I got this Evcitn Safety RV Steps, Adjustable and Folding RV Step to use at home, around the house, and to take with on trips, wanting a lightweight, easy to store, but sturdy step. That it is adjustable was a bonus. My wants and expectations have been met and my wife and I are pleased with it.

It arrived in a carrying bag, perfect for storing or traveling - for example moving it to/from your vehicle or RV. Included were instructions and a role of (what we believe is) glow in the dark tape. We have not used the tape as of yet and are waiting until we see how we use it. There is not a lot of space for the tape, so we are wishing to see where we would need to place it before doing so. The instructions are good (none for the tape), but this step is really pretty self explanatory.

The legs independently fold out easily, but have enough resistance to mean they're well connected. Once out, they give the step a nice solid, sturdy support. We both climbed up and both felt (at the lowest and second from highest heights) that it was solid under us. Being safe, but giving it "a test" we never felt like it would slip or tip over. There are non-slip strips across the surface and we felt like they did their job in keeping our feet in place. Additionally, there is a reflective strip along the side - nice for evenings or darkness when you're approaching and want to spot the step. Again, not really knowing a good spot for placing the glow tape, we're waiting to see what use teaches us about where best to place it.

We tested the legs at each level for movement (only 2 heights for testing standing on), and found them to be easy to adjust. It is the kind of adjustment where you depress the button, slide it up, and the button pops into place to hold it secure. I've never had an issue with this kind of design and this Evcitn Safety RV Steps, Adjustable and Folding RV Step appears that it is equally well made. The only "issue" we had was when refolding the legs back up, one stuck. It was difficult to get the button to depress - it was NOT wanting to go. We did finally get it - and we then noted the leg itself was a bit stiffer than the other three. For now we've decided we'd rather than it tight then loose.

Note: we were both very pleased with the idea of adjustable heights. I've looked at several that were not and am glad I waited for this one that is adjustable. That alone makes this a great find. Testing for height, my 5'7" wife was almost touching the ceiling when standing on the second from top level.

The handle is sturdy - and the same size as the step (not picture), staying secure up against it. The step is a good weight: meaning it is heavy enough to remain upright and not easily tipped, but most anyone should be able to easily move/carry it.

The step fits security - tight, but pretty easily done - in the bag. We are keeping the tape and instructions in there for now (there is no side pocket), but eventually just the step. It'll slide behind something for easy access. Or toss it in the car-truck-rv to have while on the road. It won't take up much room. While we will mainly have it in the house, we will travel with it. This step would be great for getting kayaks/SUPs on/off a car or truck, RV step, around the house for chores, among others.

In the end we are very pleased with this Evcitn Safety RV Steps, Adjustable and Folding RV Step not only for how well it's made, but the adjustable legs give us a lot of options, and it's easy for us to store away. If it lasts - and we do not see why it wouldn't - it'll be an outstanding find. We are very happy!

title: It’s a great idea and we’ll use it, but... it could be better
text:
It isn’t unheard of that we need an extra cupholder up front in the car. You get three drinks instead of one or two. Or one of the cupholders is being used for a cellphone holder. That brings us down to one already, and with two of us... so I thought about seeing if there are cupholders that had an extension for a second cup, and I found a couple, so I knew they existed. Then I had the chance to get this 2 in 1 Multifunctional Car Cup Holder Expander Adapter with Adjustable Base and grabbed it. So, would it work as well as I’d hope?

My wife and I have been trying it out and so far we are lukewarm and feeling mixed on the results. We like the idea of this thing, but it’s not exactly “perfected or perfect.” We both feel a 4 star rating is the most accurate and fair - it is good, but not great.

First, it comes in a nice box - so just for yourself, it’s normal, but it would work for a gift. But is this 2 in 1 Multifunctional Car Cup Holder Expander Adapter with Adjustable Base a gift worth giving? It depends. We put it up front, in the back of our two cupholders - the front holding a cell phone holder. It fits into the holder, but it was difficult with reduced space, to get it to lock in place. That said, it’s not just the front cup holder being used - the space in this area is at a premium, so it was difficult moving things around. So we set it in and trying to tighten it in was difficult. It kept slipping with a part of the 3 extensions moving into that opening that’s on the side. So we’d have to reset it. This happened a few times. Plus you have to twist it to tighten it, but we honestly couldn’t always get it to tighten as we twisted - the bottom itself was not letting us turn it because of the position. I can say, when we switched it to the backseat and the cupholder in the center armrest (ours is great and as deep as the front ones), we were able to get it grabbed and turned - still not set up as well as we would like or it should be - and locked in much easier. It stayed and felt “secure” in the backseat. Upfront it’s still locking in, but we don’t feel as good about the front as the backseat.

Second, the top part can stay straight up/down over the lower cupholder, or can be swung out to the side, stopping at various points, and offering a placement that seems like it’ll adjust for needs. For example, on our way home tonight we had it back up front and my wife was able to move it to have it open, but keep it from rubbing against her leg - which is something to consider - is there enough space for the extension between the holder and the passenger. In our case it’s a solid 85-90% having enough space and comfort for the passenger.

Third, there is a downside here: when extended and with nothing in the holders the thing makes a lot of racket. I mean this 2 in 1 Multifunctional Car Cup Holder Expander Adapter with Adjustable Base will bounce and shake and make noice that was driving us to distraction. We’ve already decided, unless we need it and are actively using it, we will not have it set up. It is way too distracting and annoying.

Forth, we are not 100% sure on the sizes of the cups it’ll hold. We have a larger, but common tumbler we tried - it was not fitting the lower one very well. In fact, we couldn’t feel or see, but it “felt” like it was not all the way down. When using that holder without this 2 in 1 Multifunctional Car Cup Holder Expander Adapter with Adjustable Base this tumbler fits fine. With, it felt as though it wasn’t down there and we were too unsure to let it stay. We then put it into the top - the extended adjusting part - and it fit fine. However, it also felt like the weight of the tumbler was a bit much for the 2 in 1 Multifunctional Car Cup Holder Expander Adapter with Adjustable Base. Yes, it was holding it - BUT without something in the bottom holder it was loose and we again were worried it would fall over - we did not get to test it with a cup in the bottom, but we think having something anchor it when something is in the top - especially something heavier - is a must. We also tested it with a large Starbucks cup tonight and the bottom worked fine - we did leave on the cup collar on and it fit - but JUST fit - the collar was sitting directly on top of the rim of the holder. Without the collar it fit fine.

Fifth, which brings me to the upper part - adjusting. This section allows you to adjust the three sides outward (or inward) to allow for various sizes (cups, French fries, who knows...). We tested it with both a large Starbucks cup and the tumbler and both worked fine. (Again, pay attention to weight). What is disappointing here is that you have to manually open (nothing like a button to release/open/close). This is not a big deal, but in the instructions with it there is an implication that it is adjustable without it being manual. But what got us was that it’s a little “tough” and needs a slight finessing. You can do it fine, but you’ll find that one side is easier or might get held up, or... We started to pull them all the way out, set the cup, then squeeze the sides back in to fit. It was quickest. And at this point you’ll want to be aware of where you set the top extension - if too far out and too heavy, it seems like it could (did) sort of loosen and/or risk the bottom not remaining firmly in place. We believe that you can use both the top and bottom 1. if the bottom is secured well enough, 2. you are aware of size and 3. are aware of weight of the item on the top.

In the end, this 2 in 1 Multifunctional Car Cup Holder Expander Adapter with Adjustable Base does work. But there are enough “what ifs” to give us pause. And the idea we come away with is, we can use it as intended, but there needs to be active awareness of the items you are using it for. Meaning, you have to pay careful enough attention to not make a mistake on what you out in it, or you’ll likely end up with an issue. Now, if you are actively aware and pay attention, in the end, this should be a useful tool. We will keep it in the backseat - ready for use when we need it (remember, there is far too much noise for us when not in use) and then we have it when needed. There have been enough times we’ve needed the added space (holder) so we fully believe we will get good use out of it. And as we found tonight on our latest test, we again have two spots up front for drinks - that was the bottomline for us.

Our 4 star rating we continue to believe is the best and most fair and accurate reflection of our experience with this 2 in 1 Multifunctional Car Cup Holder Expander Adapter with Adjustable Base.

title: This is a nice set for getting your car (truck, vehicle) looking nice
text:
My wife and I like keeping the car looking nice, both inside and out, and had wanted a detailing kit to help with that. We are glad to have this THINKWORK Car Wash Kit with Bucket, Pink Car Cleaning Supplies and Detailing kit and will get a lot of use out of it.

I’ll admit, we have a kit for outside, so we were not looking for that element. But this kit includes both, so in a way, for us, it’s a bonus. We’ll hold onto those pieces and use as our other ones wear out - so we can’t really speak to that at this point. They look fine, at the quality of the ones we already have, and that they’ll work - they’ll be a nice backup.

For our needs we focused on the elements of the detailing. We have not used such pieces before, so this was new to us and we have nothing to compare to. First, the set comes in a decent bag - everything has a pink color or detail. In my wife words, she doesn’t care for it. It gives her the feeling this set was “designed for some man’s idea of a woman,” and she would prefer it being a more “gender neutral” or more all encompassing color. She can’t image a man feeling all that comfortable using so much pink, but she was insulted by the idea that a woman would be. That said, it would and will not keep her from using the kit. Nor does she feel it requires lessening the 5 star rating, but she does wish the company that makes and sells this would consider a change. The bag itself is decent, but again, she suggests improvements. She would like to see the bag hold the pieces in a better way, with loops, pockets, and such to keep them in place. At present it’s just an open bag and they simply get put back in with no means by which to “control” them. Again, she did not feel - and I agree - that ways to contain them is far better, but not worth deducting any rating.

This bag set is giftable for someone looking for a practical gift. Nope, not glamorous, but for something like a family member with a new car or drivers license or White Elephant or office gift giving, this might be on point. There are enough pieces with enough uses and they work well, this could be one of those things someone doesn’t get themselves, but would really appreciate having. I know we’d appreciate it as a gift. And it looks good. Are these top level pieces? likely not. But are the functional and work for what they are intended? so far so good for us, so yes.

The pieces: Again, we have only used the ones for detailing, as we have another set already broken in for washing the outside. But we do feel these pieces are on the same track, look and feel the same, appear to have the same materials and construction, so we’ll save these for when the others are worn out - though there are a few pieces we don’t have, so they’ll get sued eventually get used.

In the mean time, the detailing pieces, what we got this for, are spot on. The bag, again works great for carrying things around. The collapsable bucket with bottom insert is great - we actually used it to carry the pieces out fo the bag - weird story - but it was easier for what we were doing. We took them out of the bag, carried in the bucket, then back. But we think it’ll work fine for soap next time we wash the car. It’s a good size, and should be fine. There is a black, bristle brush, almost looks like a toilet brush, that was perfect - we had gotten a serious amount of sand in the last few times at the beach and it was settled in. My wife used the bristle brush to pull that stuff up - keeping or removing it from being ground in - and was able to far better vacuum that stuff up - it’s not perfect looking again. Then we used the black with pink stripe brushes to coal the seems and corners of the seats, dash area, and around the frame and it pulled or lifted or moved the dirt and dust so it too was easy to get out. The car looks great tonight. There are a couple other things we used this time and in the end, the car, as mentioned, looks great. Ironically, yesterday we kept passing a professional detailing a truck in the community parking area, a bunch of equipment and a few hours. We put in about an hour and it looks excellent. We feel like we got the better end on that deal. So in the end, yes, we like and appreciate having this THINKWORK Car Wash Kit with Bucket, Pink Car Cleaning Supplies and Detailing kit.

title: Great Organizer, perfect for our needs
text:

But there is plenty of space on both sides, so do as the product page pics suggest - food, toys, whatever on both sides, or that one one and a garbage bag on the other - maybe the extra bottom piece is to replace in the case one is damaged from garbage... In the end we are thrilled with this Car Seat Organizer with Tray Car Storage Organizer and so far have gotten great use of it. We know it’ll come in very handy and it’ll get used often and for any number of things. Thrilled to have it! a

title: On one hand it’s excellent, on another it has some weaknesses, but we like it
text:
I grabbed this Seven Sparta Food & Drink Tray for Car with 5 Compartments Organizer because my wife and I are known to 1. eat in the car from time to time and 2. pick up food we do not want on the car seat. In general we feel like this is an excellent table. That said, there are a few improvements that should be made to move it from really good/great to perfect.
First, it sits well on a seat by itself - so stacking food products works. I would not trust the cup holder - not deep enough - for anything other than when stopped and the table is controlled - like not on your lap with movement. We have not tried it, but we think a multi-cup holder you’d get to carry 3 - 4 drinks should work - but... we’re not willing to try in our car, so... Stacking pizza, yep, should work. Holding your fast food bags should work.
Second, it’s built to be on an angle, so putting it on the seat works great. However, if you want to have it on your lap, to eat or work on, the legs don’t move so you have to find a way to prop it and that’s not all that easy. My wife ends up having the cup holder closest to her - but that means the cup holder and smaller area is right in front of her. It’s awkward for eating. You can’t do it off to the side - it sits too high on one side. In other words, it would be better if the legs we collapsable and you could set it on your lap for us. Then flip up the legs for propping on the seat.
But the legs are hollow and provide a small, but deep set of holes. It’s strange - we can’t figure what you’d put in them other than maybe celery sticks. Or silverware - but if it gets dirty down in there... how do you clean that?
The holes for things - if meant to work on your lap - are a bit odd shaped and in some ways too shallow. And you have to figure out how and where to balance the legs and...
Hey, this is a great idea and in many ways it works. but there are enough ways that it’s Just-That-off, that it’s a bit frustrating. I am happy we have it and my wife and I will continue to use it. I think it works enough to consider it. But I would keep an eye out for a better design.

title: This steering wheel desk works well, but...
text:
My wife and I will eat in our car from time to time and finding a place to put the food can be a challenge. I thought this JOYTUTUS Car Eating/Laptop Steering Wheel Desk might help. It does - mostly. There are a couple caveats to keep in mind. First, the desk is well assembled and the materials feel decent. If you’re working on a computer - have not tried - it seems like it’ll hold it up. In fact the week before we got this I’d been working on a computer and wished I’d had something like this. I think it might be a little high up, but for spot work or something quick, it should help. I think where it’ll help us most is the eating - we don’t do it a lot, but enough that we will stick this in back to grab - putting food around the dash gets to be difficult. That said - the space you need - this is an issue. Unless you’ve got long legs and are already pushed back, you’ll very likely need to put the driver’s seat all the way back. It is large and it needs a good deal of space. If you don’t mind this, then go for it. If you don’t want to have to readjust following your work or meal, then you can either skip this - it needs that space - or put it in the backseat and move back there. We are not sure how we’ll proceed over time - road trips and the like it would be good, but for quick stops, not so much. We have talked about having it on the backseat so it’s an easy drop down and then place things back there as needed. As of this writing, we have not made a final decision.

The idea is great and this is a well done desk. But the space is an issue. It is very easy to do on the steering wheel - just open the slot on back and slide it on. Again, the only issue is the space needed. And for kids in back, I think it’ll work great - we have not tried yet, so I don’t know how easy it is to get on back there, but the straps are pretty generally used for things and I’m sure it goes on well. How well it lays against the seat - or if the drivers feels anything - I cannot speak to.

title: This bag holder works well
